requirements.title: Customer identification, verification and ongoing monitoring obligation
requirements.description: The platform's KYC process must support customer identification, identity verification, and ongoing monitoring of customers so that the institution complies with local and international AML regulations.
requirements.quote: All financial institutions must conduct customer identification, verification, and ongoing monitoring to comply with local and international regulations.

requirements.title: KYC process must be implemented within the financial services platform
requirements.description: A Know Your Customer (KYC) process must be implemented within the financial services platform, following the regulatory requirements set out in this brief.
requirements.quote: This document outlines regulatory requirements for implementing a Know Your Customer (KYC) process within a financial services platform.

requirements.title: Alignment with FATF 40 Recommendations on AML
requirements.description: KYC requirements must be derived from and consistent with the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) 40 Recommendations on Anti-Money Laundering.
requirements.quote: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) 40 Recommendations on Anti-Money Laundering

requirements.title: Alignment with EU AML5 Directive
requirements.description: KYC requirements must be derived from and consistent with the EU Anti-Money Laundering Directive (AML5 / 5th Amendment).
requirements.quote: EU Anti-Money Laundering Directive (AML5 / 5th Amendment)

requirements.title: Alignment with PSD2 and Wolfsberg Group guidance
requirements.description: KYC requirements must also be derived from the Payment Services Directive 2 (PSD2) and Wolfsberg Group AML Guidance.
requirements.quote:
Payment Services Directive 2 (PSD2)
- Wolfsberg Group AML Guidance

requirements.title: MiFID II / MiFIR applies to investment services
requirements.description: Where the platform provides investment services, KYC requirements must additionally comply with MiFID II / MiFIR.
requirements.quote: MiFID II / MiFIR (for investment services)

requirements.title: Collect mandatory customer identification data
requirements.description: The system must capture the mandatory customer identification data set at onboarding: full legal name (surname and given names), permanent home address, date of birth, place of birth (in some jurisdictions), nationality/tax residency, occupation and economic purpose of account, source of funds declaration and PEP status.
requirements.quote: Full legal name (surname and given name(s))

requirements.title: Permanent home address must not be a P.O. Box
requirements.description: The address collected for customer identification must be a permanent home address; P.O. Box addresses are not acceptable.
requirements.quote: Permanent home address (not P.O. Box)

requirements.title: Capture occupation and economic purpose of account
requirements.description: The customer's occupation and the economic purpose of the account must be recorded as part of customer identification.
requirements.quote: Occupation and economic purpose of account

requirements.title: Capture source of funds declaration
requirements.description: A source of funds declaration must be collected from the customer during identification.
requirements.quote: Source of funds declaration

requirements.title: Determine and record PEP status
requirements.description: Politically Exposed Person (PEP) status must be established and recorded as part of mandatory customer identification data collection.
requirements.quote: Politically Exposed Person (PEP) status

requirements.title: Verify identity with government-issued photo ID
requirements.description: Identity verification must accept government-issued photo identification such as a passport, national ID or driver's license.
requirements.quote: Government-issued photo identification (passport, national ID, driver's license)

requirements.title: Proof of address must be dated within the last 3 months
requirements.description: Accepted proof of address documents (utility bill, government correspondence, rental agreement) must be dated within the last 3 months to be valid for verification.
requirements.quote: Proof of address (utility bill, government correspondence, rental agreement) dated within last 3 months

requirements.title: Biometric video verification for remote onboarding
requirements.description: Where applicable, biometric verification must be supported, including video verification for remote onboarding channels.
requirements.quote: Biometric verification where applicable (video verification for remote onboarding)

requirements.title: Third-party data provider verification
requirements.description: Verification must be able to draw on third-party data providers, including credit bureaus and sanctions screening services.
requirements.quote: Third-party data provider verification (credit bureaus, sanctions screening)

requirements.title: Verification completed before account activation
requirements.description: Customer verification must be fully completed before the account can be activated.
requirements.quote: Verification must be completed BEFORE account activation

requirements.title: Failed verification triggers compliance escalation
requirements.description: Any failed verification attempt must automatically trigger escalation to the compliance team.
requirements.quote: Failed verification attempts must trigger escalation to compliance team

requirements.title: Retain verification documents 5 years post-closure
requirements.description: Verification documents must be retained for a minimum of 5 years after the account is closed.
requirements.quote: Verification documents must be retained for minimum 5 years post-account closure

requirements.title: Liveness check required for remote onboarding
requirements.description: Remote onboarding journeys must include a liveness check to prevent fraudulent use of identity documents.
requirements.quote: Remote onboarding must include liveness check to prevent fraudulent use of documents

requirements.title: Standard CDD baseline documentation for retail customers
requirements.description: Standard CDD for retail customers requires a baseline of a government-issued ID plus proof of address.
requirements.quote: Baseline: Government ID + Proof of Address

requirements.title: Additional beneficial ownership verification for high-risk retail customers
requirements.description: For customers classified as high-risk under standard CDD, additional beneficial ownership verification must be performed.
requirements.quote: Enhanced: Additional beneficial ownership verification for high-risk customers

requirements.title: Risk factors considered in standard CDD
requirements.description: Standard CDD risk assessment must consider age, transaction volume, geography and business type as risk factors.
requirements.quote: Risk factors: Age, transaction volume, geography, business type

requirements.title: Mandatory EDD trigger categories
requirements.description: Enhanced Due Diligence is mandatory for PEPs, High-Net-Worth customers (over $1M), customers in high-risk jurisdictions, and correspondent banking relationships.
requirements.quote: Mandatory for: PEPs, High-Net-Worth (>$1M), High-risk jurisdictions, Correspondent banking

requirements.title: EDD source of wealth investigation
requirements.description: EDD cases require a detailed investigation into the customer's source of wealth.
requirements.quote: Detailed source of wealth investigation

requirements.title: Ongoing transaction monitoring for EDD customers
requirements.description: Customers subject to EDD must be placed under ongoing transaction monitoring.
requirements.quote: Ongoing transaction monitoring

requirements.title: Business purpose documentation for EDD
requirements.description: EDD requires documentation of the business purpose of the customer relationship.
requirements.quote: Business purpose documentation

requirements.title: Beneficial ownership chain resolved to 25% threshold
requirements.description: EDD requires mapping the beneficial ownership chain up to a 25% ownership threshold.
requirements.quote: Beneficial ownership chain (up to 25% threshold)

requirements.title: Minimum annual review frequency for EDD customers
requirements.description: EDD customers must be reviewed at minimum annually, with more frequent reviews for the highest-risk categories.
requirements.quote: Enhanced review frequency: Minimum annual, more frequent for highest-risk categories

requirements.title: Simplified CDD for low-risk EU/EEA customers
requirements.description: Low-risk customers located in the EU/EEA are eligible for simplified CDD.
requirements.quote: Low-risk customers in EU/EEA

requirements.title: Simplified CDD for minors with parental verification
requirements.description: Customers under 18 years of age qualify for simplified CDD where parental verification is provided.
requirements.quote: Age <18 with parental verification

requirements.title: Simplified CDD for government-overseen non-profits
requirements.description: Non-profit organizations subject to government oversight are eligible for simplified CDD.
requirements.quote: Non-profit organizations with government oversight

requirements.title: Simplified CDD for listed public companies
requirements.description: Public companies listed on major exchanges are eligible for simplified CDD.
requirements.quote: Public companies listed on major exchanges

requirements.title: Mutual consent exemption in some jurisdictions
requirements.description: In some jurisdictions mutual consent is not required for simplified CDD exemptions.
requirements.quote: Mutual consent not required for some jurisdictions

requirements.title: Quarterly standard monitoring review
requirements.description: Customers on the standard risk track must have their customer profile and transactions reviewed on a quarterly cycle.
requirements.quote: Standard: Quarterly review of customer profile and transactions

requirements.title: Monthly review for EDD customers
requirements.description: Customers subject to Enhanced Due Diligence must be reviewed monthly rather than quarterly.
requirements.quote: Enhanced: Monthly review for EDD customers, weekly for highest-risk

requirements.title: Weekly review for highest-risk customers
requirements.description: Customers classified as highest-risk must be reviewed on a weekly cadence.
requirements.quote: Enhanced: Monthly review for EDD customers, weekly for highest-risk

requirements.title: Real-time alerting on transaction threshold breach
requirements.description: The system must generate real-time alerts when a transaction breaches the threshold of €10,000 per transaction in the EU.
requirements.quote: Transaction-based: Real-time alerts on threshold breach (€10,000 per transaction in EU)

requirements.title: Single transaction monitoring trigger of €10,000
requirements.description: Any single transaction exceeding €10,000 (or equivalent in another currency) triggers monitoring review.
requirements.quote: Transactions exceeding €10,000 single transaction (or equivalent)

requirements.title: Cumulative threshold trigger of €50,000 per 30 days
requirements.description: Cumulative transaction activity breaching €50,000 within a rolling 30-day window triggers monitoring review.
requirements.quote: Cumulative threshold breach: €50,000 per 30-day window

requirements.title: Customer profile change trigger
requirements.description: Changes in the customer profile — including occupation, address or beneficial owners — trigger monitoring review.
requirements.quote: Changes in customer profile (occupation, address, beneficial owners)

requirements.title: High-risk country activity trigger
requirements.description: Transaction activity involving high-risk countries triggers monitoring review.
requirements.quote: High-risk country transaction activity

requirements.title: Structuring pattern detection trigger
requirements.description: Patterns indicating structuring activity (potential circumvention of thresholds) must trigger monitoring review.
requirements.quote: Structuring activity patterns (potential circumvention)

requirements.title: Sanctions list match trigger
requirements.description: Matches against sanctions lists — OFAC SDN, EU consolidated lists and national lists — trigger monitoring review.
requirements.quote: Sanctions list matches (OFAC SDN, EU consolidated lists, national lists)

requirements.title: Automated transaction screening against sanctions lists
requirements.description: The system must automatically screen transactions against sanctions lists as part of ongoing monitoring.
requirements.quote: Automated transaction screening against sanctions lists

requirements.title: Behavioral analytics for baseline deviation
requirements.description: The system must apply behavioral analytics to detect deviation from a customer's baseline transaction patterns.
requirements.quote: Behavioral analytics (deviation from baseline patterns)

requirements.title: Manual review of flagged transactions
requirements.description: Transactions flagged by monitoring must be subject to manual review by a compliance analyst.
requirements.quote: Manual review of flagged transactions

requirements.title: Customer contact within 72 hours of unusual activity
requirements.description: Where unusual activity is detected, the customer must be contacted within 72 hours.
requirements.quote: Customer contact for unusual activity (within 72 hours)

requirements.title: SAR filing to Financial Intelligence Unit
requirements.description: Suspicious Activity Reports must be filed with the Financial Intelligence Unit as a monitoring action.
requirements.quote: Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) filing to Financial Intelligence Unit

requirements.title: Account suspension and closure authority
requirements.description: The compliance function must have the authority to suspend or close accounts in extreme cases arising from monitoring.
requirements.quote: Account suspension/closure authority in extreme cases

requirements.title: Identify all ultimate beneficial owners
requirements.description: The system must support identification of all natural persons who ultimately own or control the customer entity.
requirements.quote: Identify all natural persons who ultimately own/control the customer

requirements.title: 25% beneficial ownership threshold
requirements.description: A natural person qualifies as a beneficial owner where direct or indirect ownership is 25% or greater.
requirements.quote: Threshold: Direct or indirect ownership ≥25%

requirements.title: BO information required before account activation
requirements.description: Beneficial ownership information must be obtained before the customer account can be activated.
requirements.quote: Obtain BO information before account activation

requirements.title: Ownership structure documentation
requirements.description: Documentation of beneficial ownership must include an ownership structure diagram together with supporting evidence.
requirements.quote: Documentation: Ownership structure diagram + supporting evidence

requirements.title: Corporate registry search for legal entities
requirements.description: For legal entity customers, a corporate registry search must be performed to confirm the legal structure.
requirements.quote: Corporate registry search (confirmation of legal structure)

requirements.title: Shareholder register review covering last 2 years
requirements.description: For legal entities, the shareholder register must be reviewed covering a minimum of the last 2 years where available.
requirements.quote: Shareholder register review (minimum last 2 years if available)

requirements.title: Governance documents for legal entities
requirements.description: Board meeting minutes or shareholder resolutions must be collected for legal entity customers.
requirements.quote: Board meeting minutes or shareholder resolutions

requirements.title: Trust documents for trust accounts
requirements.description: Trust documents must be obtained where the customer is a trust account.
requirements.quote: Trust documents (for trust accounts)

requirements.title: Identify trust parties
requirements.description: For trusts, the settlor, trustee, beneficiaries and protector must all be identified.
requirements.quote: Identify settlor, trustee, beneficiaries, protector

requirements.title: Obtain trust deed and beneficiary schedule
requirements.description: The trust deed and beneficiary schedule must be obtained for trust customers.
requirements.quote: Obtain trust deed and beneficiary schedule

requirements.title: Ongoing review on change of beneficial interest
requirements.description: An ongoing review must be triggered whenever beneficial interest in the trust changes.
requirements.quote: Ongoing review if beneficial interest changes
requirements.trigger: Change in beneficial interest

requirements.title: Maintain FATF black list of non-cooperative jurisdictions
requirements.description: The system must maintain and apply the FATF Black List of non-cooperative countries, which as of 2024 includes Iran and North Korea (DPRK).
requirements.quote: FATF Black List (Non-Cooperative Countries): Iran, North Korea (DPRK), as of this date

requirements.title: Maintain FATF grey list of jurisdictions under increased monitoring
requirements.description: Jurisdictions on the FATF Grey List (under increased monitoring) must be tracked as high-risk jurisdictions.
requirements.quote: FATF Grey List: Jurisdictions under increased monitoring

requirements.title: Quarterly update of EU high-risk jurisdiction list
requirements.description: The EU High-Risk Jurisdictions list must be updated on a quarterly basis.
requirements.quote: EU High-Risk Jurisdictions: Updated quarterly

requirements.title: Maintain OFAC SDN list
requirements.description: The OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List must be maintained as part of the high-risk jurisdiction and sanctions reference data.
requirements.quote: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List

requirements.title: Real-time sanctions and PEP screening at onboarding
requirements.description: At onboarding, the system must screen customer name plus date of birth in real time against the OFAC SDN List, EU sanctions list, UN Security Council consolidated list, national sanctions lists and PEP databases.
requirements.quote: Real-time screening at onboarding: Customer name + DOB against:

requirements.title: Screening match threshold
requirements.description: A screening alert is raised only on an exact match or a high-confidence phonetic match.
requirements.quote: Match threshold: Exact or high-confidence phonetic match

requirements.title: Human review of potential false positives before rejection
requirements.description: Every potential screening match must undergo human compliance review before a customer can be rejected; automated rejection without review is not permitted.
requirements.quote: False positive review: Human compliance review before rejection

requirements.title: Weekly ongoing re-screening of active customers
requirements.description: Active customers must be re-screened against sanctions and PEP lists on a weekly basis.
requirements.quote: Ongoing re-screening: Weekly for active customers

requirements.title: PEP status as a high-risk factor
requirements.description: A customer or beneficial owner who is a PEP or PEP-related must be treated as a high-risk factor.
requirements.quote: Customer or beneficial owner is PEP or PEP-related

requirements.title: Jurisdiction-based high-risk factor
requirements.description: Jurisdiction risk factors include FATF grey-list membership, high corruption index and weak AML controls.
requirements.quote: Jurisdiction: FATF grey-list, high corruption index, weak AML controls

requirements.title: Business-type high-risk factor
requirements.description: Business types showing trade-based money laundering indicators or bulk cash activity are high-risk factors.
requirements.quote: Business type: Trade-based money laundering indicators, bulk cash business

requirements.title: Transaction pattern high-risk factor
requirements.description: Transaction patterns such as structuring, rapid in/out flows and unusual trade patterns are high-risk factors.
requirements.quote: Transaction patterns: Structuring, rapid in/out flows, unusual trade patterns

requirements.title: Correspondent banking high-risk factor
requirements.description: Correspondent banking relationships involving third countries or correspondent exposure are high-risk factors.
requirements.quote: Correspondent banking: Third-country involvement, correspondent exposure

requirements.title: PEP definition covers office holders, family and close associates
requirements.description: The system must classify as PEPs current holders of high public office (President, Minister, judiciary, senior military rank), their immediate family members, and known close associates.
requirements.quote: Current holders of high public office (President, Minister, judiciary, military senior rank)

requirements.title: PEP scope extends to international organization senior staff
requirements.description: PEP classification must also be applied to senior staff of international organizations.
requirements.quote: Applies to international organizations' senior staff

requirements.title: Automated PEP database screening
requirements.description: The system must screen customers automatically against PEP databases such as World-Check, Refinitiv and Dow Jones.
requirements.quote: Automated screening against PEP databases (World-Check, Refinitiv, Dow Jones)

requirements.title: Enhanced due diligence before PEP account opening
requirements.description: Enhanced due diligence must be completed before an account is opened for an identified PEP.
requirements.quote: Enhanced due diligence before account opening

requirements.title: Family relationship screening
requirements.description: The system must screen for family relationships using indicators such as surnames, addresses and shared information to identify PEP relatives.
requirements.quote: Family relationship screening (surnames, addresses, shared information)

requirements.title: Annual PEP re-screening
requirements.description: Customers must be re-screened against PEP databases at least annually.
requirements.quote: Annual re-screening

requirements.title: Mandatory escalation of PEP matches to Compliance Officer
requirements.description: Any PEP identification must be escalated to the Compliance Officer as a mandatory step.
requirements.quote: Mandatory escalation to Compliance Officer

requirements.title: Enhanced source of funds documentation for PEPs
requirements.description: Enhanced source of funds documentation must be collected for identified PEPs.
requirements.quote: Enhanced source of funds documentation

requirements.title: Business rationale documentation for PEP relationships
requirements.description: The business rationale for entering into a relationship with a PEP must be documented.
requirements.quote: Business rationale documentation

requirements.title: Documented approval before PEP account activation
requirements.description: Documented approval must be obtained before a PEP account can be activated.
requirements.quote: Approval required before account activation (documented)

requirements.title: Senior management sign-off for PEP relationships
requirements.description: Senior management sign-off is required for PEP customer relationships.
requirements.quote: Senior management sign-off required

requirements.title: Quarterly review of PEP relationships
requirements.description: PEP relationships must be reviewed at a minimum quarterly.
requirements.quote: Quarterly review minimum

requirements.title: Collect mandatory KYC documentation set
requirements.description: The system must capture and store the required onboarding documentation for every customer: government-issued ID (photocopy or scan), proof of address (recent utility bill or equivalent), beneficial ownership documentation, source of funds/wealth declaration, customer risk assessment form, and compliance review notes.
requirements.quote:
- Government-issued ID (photocopy or scan)
- Proof of address (recent utility bill or equivalent)
- Beneficial ownership documentation
- Source of funds/wealth declaration
- Customer risk assessment form
- Compliance review notes

requirements.title: Proof of address must be recent
requirements.description: Proof of address evidence must be a recent utility bill or an equivalent document.
requirements.quote: Proof of address (recent utility bill or equivalent)

requirements.title: Minimum five-year retention after account closure
requirements.description: Customer documentation and records must be retained for a minimum of 5 years after account closure, or after transaction completion where applicable.
requirements.quote: Minimum 5 years after account closure (or transaction completion)

requirements.title: EU AML5 five-year retention obligation
requirements.description: For EU customers, records must be retained for a minimum of 5 years to satisfy the AML5 requirement.
requirements.quote: EU requirement: 5 years minimum for AML5

requirements.title: Support extended jurisdictional retention of 7-10 years
requirements.description: The retention configuration must accommodate jurisdictions that require records to be held for 7 to 10 years, beyond the 5-year baseline.
requirements.quote: Some jurisdictions require 7-10 years

requirements.title: Digital storage with 10-day retrieval for regulator requests
requirements.description: Records may be stored digitally, but stored records must be retrievable within 10 days when requested by a regulator.
requirements.quote: Digital storage acceptable; must be retrievable within 10 days for regulator requests

requirements.title: Audit trail for document submission and verification
requirements.description: The system must record an audit trail containing document submission date/time, document verification date/time, the analyst performing verification, and the verification status (approved/rejected/escalated).
requirements.quote:
- Document submission date/time
- Document verification date/time
- Analyst performing verification
- Verification status (approved/rejected/escalated)

requirements.title: Log all customer profile changes
requirements.description: Every change to a customer profile must be logged with date, time, the field changed, the old and new values, and the analyst who made the change.
requirements.quote: Changes to customer profile: date, time, field changed, old/new value, analyst

requirements.title: Verification status values are constrained
requirements.description: The verification status recorded in the audit trail must be one of approved, rejected, or escalated.
requirements.quote: Verification status (approved/rejected/escalated)

requirements.title: Escalate on verification failure
requirements.description: Cases must be escalated when identity verification fails, including failed ID verification, address mismatch, or a sanctions match.
requirements.quote: Verification failure (failed ID verification, address mismatch, sanctions match)

requirements.title: Escalate high-risk customer profiles
requirements.description: A customer profile flagged as high risk — PEP status, high-risk jurisdiction, or high transaction volume — triggers escalation.
requirements.quote: High-risk customer profile (PEP, high-risk jurisdiction, high transaction volume)

requirements.title: Escalate suspicious transactions or patterns
requirements.description: Detection of a suspicious transaction or transaction pattern is an escalation trigger.
requirements.quote: Suspicious transaction or pattern

requirements.title: Escalate complex beneficial ownership structures
requirements.description: Beneficial ownership complexity triggers escalation where the ownership structure exceeds 5 layers or involves shell companies.
requirements.quote: Beneficial ownership complexity (>5 layers, shell companies)

requirements.title: Escalate when customer cannot be verified
requirements.description: Escalation is triggered when a customer is unable to be verified due to missing documentation or the absence of a legitimate address.
requirements.quote: Customer unable to verify (missing documentation, no legitimate address)

requirements.title: Compliance Officer review within 2 business days
requirements.description: Every escalated case must be reviewed by a Compliance Officer within 2 business days of escalation.
requirements.quote: Escalated cases reviewed by Compliance Officer within 2 business days

requirements.title: Compliance Officer reviews and decides on escalated case
requirements.description: A Compliance Officer picks up an escalated case, reviews it within the 2 business day window, records a decision of approve, reject, or request additional information, and where rejected the customer is notified and offered an appeal.
requirements.quote: Documentation of decision (approve/reject/request additional info)
requirements.trigger: A case is escalated for compliance review
requirements.happyPath: Compliance Officer reviews the escalated case within 2 business days, records the decision (approve/reject/request additional info) with supporting documentation, and the customer is notified of a rejection within the legally specified timeframe with appeal information.

requirements.title: Record decision outcome on escalated cases
requirements.description: The system must capture documentation of the review decision, with outcomes of approve, reject, or request additional information.
requirements.quote: Documentation of decision (approve/reject/request additional info)

requirements.title: Notify customer of rejection decision
requirements.description: Customers must be notified of a rejection decision within the timeframe specified by law.
requirements.quote: Customer notification of rejection decision (within timeframe specified by law)

requirements.title: Appeal process available to customers
requirements.description: An appeal process must be available to customers following a compliance decision.
requirements.quote: Appeal process availability

requirements.title: Limited use account opening pending verification
requirements.description: The system must support opening an account with restricted, limited use while verification is still pending.
requirements.quote: Limited use account opening (restricted pending verification)

requirements.title: Account freeze authority during review
requirements.description: The system must provide authority and capability to freeze an account while a compliance review is in progress.
requirements.quote: Account freeze authority during review

requirements.title: Reversal of account opening post-review
requirements.description: The system must support reversing an account opening after the compliance review concludes.
requirements.quote: Reversal of account opening post-review

requirements.title: Communicate restriction reasons to customer
requirements.description: Customers must be informed of the reasons for any restrictions placed on their account.
requirements.quote: Customer communication of restriction reasons

requirements.title: SAR filing triggered by suspected ML/TF
requirements.description: The system must require filing of a Suspicious Activity Report when a transaction or pattern indicates money laundering or terrorism financing.
requirements.quote: Filing requirement: Transaction or pattern indicates money laundering or terrorism financing

requirements.title: SAR filing timeline
requirements.description: SARs must be reported within the required timeframe, which varies by jurisdiction and is typically 5 working days in the EU.
requirements.quote: Timeline: Report within required timeframe (varies by jurisdiction, typically 5 working days in EU)

requirements.title: Mandatory SAR content fields
requirements.description: A SAR must contain customer information, transaction details, the reason for suspicion, the amount, and relevant dates.
requirements.quote: Contents: Customer info, transaction details, reason for suspicion, amount, dates

requirements.title: SAR confidentiality and no tipping off
requirements.description: SAR filings are confidential and disclosure of the filing to the customer is prohibited.
requirements.quote: Confidentiality: SAR filing is confidential; disclosure to customer prohibited

requirements.title: CTR threshold of €10,000 in a single transaction
requirements.description: A Currency Transaction Report threshold applies to single transactions of €10,000 or equivalent.
requirements.quote: Threshold: €10,000 or equivalent in single transaction

requirements.title: Document and monitor CTR-threshold transactions
requirements.description: Transactions meeting the CTR threshold must be documented and monitored, and may trigger a SAR if a pattern is detected.
requirements.quote: Requirement: Document and monitor; may trigger SAR if pattern detected

requirements.title: Cumulative CTR reporting support
requirements.description: The system must support cumulative transaction reporting, which is required in some jurisdictions.
requirements.quote: Cumulative reporting in some jurisdictions

requirements.title: Immediate escalation on confirmed sanctions match
requirements.description: A confirmed sanctions match must be escalated immediately.
requirements.quote: Immediate escalation if sanctions match confirmed

requirements.title: Report sanctions violations to the FIU
requirements.description: Sanctions violations must be reported to the financial intelligence unit (FIU).
requirements.quote: Reporting to financial intelligence unit (FIU)

requirements.title: Asset freeze procedures
requirements.description: Asset freeze procedures must be available and applied following a confirmed sanctions match.
requirements.quote: Asset freeze procedures

requirements.title: No customer notification of sanctions case without authority approval
requirements.description: Customers must not be notified about a sanctions matter unless the relevant authority has approved the notification.
requirements.quote: No customer notification without authority approval

requirements.title: Customer Identity Verification completed before account opening
requirements.description: The Customer Identity Verification (CIV) must be completed by the onboarding team before an account is opened, with an audit trail evidenced by document upload.
requirements.quote: | CIV Completion | Before account opening | Onboarding team | Yes - Document upload |

requirements.title: Verification performed same day by compliance analyst
requirements.description: Verification must be carried out on the same day by a compliance analyst, and the verification result must be recorded as an audit trail.
requirements.quote: | Verification | Same day | Compliance analyst | Yes - Verification result |

requirements.title: CDD assessment before account activation
requirements.description: A Customer Due Diligence risk assessment must be completed before the account is activated, with the risk score and analyst notes retained as an audit trail.
requirements.quote: | CDD Assessment | Before account activation | Risk assessment | Yes - Risk score + notes |

requirements.title: Real-time PEP screening at account opening
requirements.description: PEP screening must run in real time at account opening, combining automated screening with manual review, and the screening result must be logged.
requirements.quote: | PEP Screening | Real-time at opening | Automated + Manual review | Yes - Screening result |

requirements.title: Sanctions screening in real time with weekly ongoing rescreening
requirements.description: The automated system must perform sanctions screening in real time and on an ongoing weekly basis, logging every match and no-match outcome.
requirements.quote: | Sanctions Screening | Real-time, ongoing weekly | Automated system | Yes - Match/no match log |

requirements.title: Quarterly minimum ongoing monitoring
requirements.description: The compliance team must perform ongoing monitoring at a minimum frequency of quarterly, recording the review date and the action taken.
requirements.quote: | Ongoing Monitoring | Quarterly minimum | Compliance team | Yes - Review date + action taken |

requirements.title: Enhanced monitoring monthly or weekly according to risk
requirements.description: Enhanced monitoring must be performed monthly or weekly depending on the customer's risk level, by a dedicated analyst, with escalation notes retained.
requirements.quote: | Enhanced Monitoring | Monthly/weekly per risk | Dedicated analyst | Yes - Escalation notes |

requirements.title: SAR filing within regulatory timeline by Compliance Officer
requirements.description: Suspicious Activity Report filing is the responsibility of the Compliance Officer and must occur within the regulatory timeline, with filing confirmation retained as an audit trail.
requirements.quote: | SAR Filing | Within regulatory timeline | Compliance Officer | Yes - Filing confirmation |

requirements.title: Retain documentation 5-10 years post-closure
requirements.description: Documentation must be retained for 5 to 10 years after account closure, jointly managed by Compliance and Archives, with a retention policy log kept as audit trail.
requirements.quote: | Documentation Retention | 5-10 years post-closure | Compliance + Archives | Yes - Retention policy log |

requirements.title: Audit trail required for every compliance obligation
requirements.description: The system must maintain an audit trail for each compliance obligation listed — document upload, verification result, risk score and notes, screening results, match/no-match logs, review dates and actions, escalation notes, filing confirmations and retention policy logs.
requirements.quote: | Requirement | Timing | Responsibility | Audit Trail Required |

requirements.title: Low Risk classification (Score 1-2)
requirements.description: Customers scoring 1-2 are classified Low Risk: EU/EEA retail customer, transparent business, low transaction volume, and no risk flags.
requirements.quote: **Low Risk (Score 1-2):** EU/EEA retail customer, transparent business, low transaction volume, no risk flags

requirements.title: Medium Risk classification (Score 3-5)
requirements.description: Customers scoring 3-5 are classified Medium Risk: standard business customer, moderate transaction volume, high-risk jurisdiction connection, or age-related factors.
requirements.quote: **Medium Risk (Score 3-5):** Standard business customer, moderate transaction volume, high-risk jurisdiction connection, age-related

requirements.title: High Risk classification (Score 6-8)
requirements.description: Customers scoring 6-8 are classified High Risk: PEP-related, high-risk jurisdiction, high transaction volume, or cash-intensive business.
requirements.quote: **High Risk (Score 6-8):** PEP-related, high-risk jurisdiction, high transaction volume, cash-intensive business

requirements.title: Extreme Risk classification (Score 9-10)
requirements.description: Customers scoring 9-10 are classified Extreme Risk: sanctioned jurisdiction, obvious shell company, politically connected, or structuring patterns.
requirements.quote: **Extreme Risk (Score 9-10):** Sanctioned jurisdiction, obvious shell company, politically connected, structuring patterns

requirements.title: Risk score drives CDD level and monitoring frequency
requirements.description: The calculated risk score must determine the applicable customer due diligence level and the frequency of ongoing monitoring for the customer.
requirements.quote: Risk score determines CDD level and ongoing monitoring frequency.

requirements.title: Explainable AI customer risk scoring model
requirements.description: If AI is used to score customer risk, the model must be explainable so the compliance team can understand which factors drive the score.
requirements.quote: **Algorithmic Risk Assessment:** If using AI to score customer risk, model must be explainable; compliance team must understand scoring factors

requirements.title: Bias testing of automated screening systems
requirements.description: Automated screening systems must be tested for gender, age and nationality bias in customer rejection rates.
requirements.quote: **Bias Testing:** Automated screening systems must be tested for gender/age/nationality bias in customer rejection rates

requirements.title: Human review required for high-risk decisions
requirements.description: High-risk decisions must include human review; AI may not be the sole determinant for rejecting an account.
requirements.quote: **Human Review Mandate:** High-risk decisions must include human review; AI cannot make sole determination for account rejection

requirements.title: Disclose AI use to the customer
requirements.description: The customer must be informed when AI was used in reaching their assessment decision.
requirements.quote: **Transparency:** Customer must be informed if AI was used in their assessment decision

requirements.title: Audit trail of AI model versions, training data and metrics
requirements.description: The platform must maintain an audit trail covering all AI model versions, training data and performance metrics, available for regulatory inspection.
requirements.quote: **Record Keeping:** Maintain audit trail of all AI model versions, training data, and performance metrics for regulatory inspection

requirements.title: No account opened without complete CIV verification
requirements.description: The system must prevent any account from being opened unless Customer Identity Verification (CIV) is complete. Success is measured as zero accounts opened without complete CIV verification.
requirements.quote: Zero accounts opened without complete CIV verification

requirements.title: Full audit trail on customer creation events
requirements.description: 100% of customer creation events must be captured with an audit trail recording the analyst and timestamp.
requirements.quote: 100% of customer creation events captured with analyst/timestamp audit trail

requirements.title: Real-time sanctions screening under 100ms
requirements.description: Sanctions screening must run in real time and return results with latency below 100 milliseconds.
requirements.quote: Real-time sanctions screening with <100ms latency

requirements.title: Fully automated monthly monitoring report generation
requirements.description: Monthly monitoring reports must be generated automatically with zero manual intervention.
requirements.quote: Automated monthly monitoring report generation (zero manual intervention)

requirements.title: Escalation case assignment within 2 business days
requirements.description: Escalated cases must be assigned within the service level agreement of 2 business days.
requirements.quote: Escalation case assignment within SLA (2 business days)

requirements.title: Verifiable 5-year document retention
requirements.description: Document retention must be compliant and demonstrably verifiable over a 5-year retention period.
requirements.quote: Document retention compliance (verifiable 5-year retention)

requirements.title: Regulatory reporting workflow with templates and submission tracking
requirements.description: A regulatory reporting workflow must exist providing reporting templates and tracking of submissions.
requirements.quote: Regulatory reporting workflow with template + submission tracking

requirements.title: Automated identity verification, risk assessment and ongoing monitoring
requirements.description: The KYC platform must automate identity verification, risk assessment, and ongoing monitoring as core capabilities of the onboarding workflow.
requirements.quote: The KYC platform must automate identity verification, risk assessment, and ongoing monitoring

requirements.title: Standard customer manual review time under 2 hours
requirements.description: Automation must reduce manual review time for standard customers from the current 48 hours to less than 2 hours.
requirements.quote: reduce manual review time from 48 hours to <2 hours for standard customers

requirements.title: Regulatory compliance across EU/UK jurisdictions
requirements.description: The platform must maintain regulatory compliance across EU and UK jurisdictions while enabling rapid customer onboarding.
requirements.quote: Enable rapid customer onboarding while maintaining regulatory compliance across EU/UK jurisdictions.

requirements.title: MVP scope limited to onboarding workflow with verification and monitoring
requirements.description: The MVP release scope is the customer onboarding workflow including verification and monitoring, targeted for the Q2 2025 release.
requirements.quote: **Scope:** MVP - Customer onboarding workflow with verification and monitoring

requirements.title: Electronic collection of ID and proof of address documents
requirements.description: The CIV module must allow customer service representatives to collect government ID and proof of address documents electronically, removing the need for physical copies.
requirements.quote: As a customer service representative, I want to collect government ID and proof of address documents electronically so that I don't have to request physical copies.
requirements.trigger: Customer onboarding requires identity documentation
requirements.happyPath: Representative uploads the customer's government ID and proof of address electronically; the system accepts, detects the document type and extracts key fields via OCR.

requirements.title: Supported document formats and size limit
requirements.description: Document upload accepts only PDF, JPG, PNG and TIFF files, with a maximum size of 20MB per document.
requirements.quote: Supported formats: PDF, JPG, PNG, TIFF (max 20MB per document)

requirements.title: Automated document type detection
requirements.description: The system automatically detects the type of the uploaded identity document, distinguishing passport, national ID and driver's license.
requirements.quote: Automated document type detection (ID type: passport, national ID, driver's license)

requirements.title: OCR extraction of key identity fields
requirements.description: OCR must extract Name, Date of Birth, Expiry date, ID number and Issue country from uploaded identity documents.
requirements.quote: OCR extraction of key fields: Name, DOB, Expiry date, ID number, Issue country

requirements.title: Document quality checks
requirements.description: Uploaded documents must pass quality checks: minimum resolution of 300 DPI, all text readable, and all four corners visible.
requirements.quote: Document quality checks: Resolution minimum 300 DPI, all text readable, four corners visible

requirements.title: Basic tamper detection in MVP
requirements.description: The MVP performs basic tamper detection via a pixel-level consistency check; cryptographic verification is explicitly excluded from the MVP.
requirements.quote: Tamper detection: Basic (pixel-level consistency check) - no cryptographic verification in MVP

requirements.title: Encrypted, segregated document storage with 5-year retention
requirements.description: Documents are stored in an encrypted S3 bucket kept separate from customer profile data, under a 5-year retention policy.
requirements.quote: Storage: Encrypted S3 bucket, separate from customer profile data, 5-year retention policy

requirements.title: Document upload performance target
requirements.description: A standard 5MB document upload must complete in under 10 seconds.
requirements.quote: Document upload completes in <10 seconds for standard 5MB file

requirements.title: OCR accuracy threshold for Western European IDs
requirements.description: OCR accuracy must exceed 95% for Western European ID formats.
requirements.quote: OCR accuracy >95% for Western European ID formats

requirements.title: Clear error message on rejected documents
requirements.description: When a document is rejected, the system displays a clear, actionable error message such as "Blurry document - retake required".
requirements.quote: Rejected documents display clear error message (e.g., "Blurry document - retake required")

requirements.title: Document upload audit trail contents
requirements.description: The audit trail must capture upload time, document type, OCR confidence score and analyst review timestamp.
requirements.quote: Audit trail captures: upload time, document type, OCR confidence score, analyst review timestamp

requirements.title: Failed OCR routes to manual review queue
requirements.description: When OCR fails, the case is automatically routed into the compliance analyst manual review queue.
requirements.quote: Failed OCR triggers manual review workflow (compliance analyst review queue)

requirements.title: Automated flagging of data inconsistencies for compliance review
requirements.description: Compliance officers rely on automated checks that flag inconsistencies between customer-supplied input and document information so that only high-risk cases require manual review.
requirements.quote: As a compliance officer, I want automated checks to flag inconsistencies between customer input and document information so that I only manually review high-risk cases.
requirements.trigger: Customer submits identity documents and profile data
requirements.happyPath: The verification engine compares customer-supplied data with OCR-extracted data, passes consistent cases automatically, and flags only inconsistent or high-risk cases to the compliance officer.

requirements.title: Name matching tolerance
requirements.description: Customer-supplied name is matched against OCR extraction using exact plus phonetic matching, allowing a variance of 1 character.
requirements.quote: Name (exact + phonetic match, allow 1 character variance)

requirements.title: Date of birth must match exactly
requirements.description: Customer-supplied date of birth must be an exact match to the OCR-extracted date of birth; no variance is permitted.
requirements.quote: Date of birth (exact match only)

requirements.title: Address matching criteria
requirements.description: Address matching is performed on street number and postal code between customer-supplied data and the document.
requirements.quote: Address (street number + postal code match)

requirements.title: ID expiry rejection threshold
requirements.description: The ID expiry date is compared against the current date and the document is rejected if it expired more than 6 months ago.
requirements.quote: Compare ID expiry against current date (reject if expired >6 months)

requirements.title: National ID registry cross-reference
requirements.description: The ID number is cross-referenced against the national ID registry where an API is available, specifically Estonia, Lithuania and Latvia.
requirements.quote: Cross-reference ID number against national ID registry (where API available: Estonia, Lithuania, Latvia)

requirements.title: Proof of address recency
requirements.description: Proof of address documents must be less than 3 months old.
requirements.quote: Document recency check: Proof of address <3 months old

requirements.title: Manual review triggers
requirements.description: A case is flagged for manual review when there is a name mismatch, an expired ID, or inconsistent information.
requirements.quote: Flag for manual review if: Name mismatch, expired ID, inconsistent information

requirements.title: Verification latency target
requirements.description: Automated verification must complete in under 30 seconds per customer.
requirements.quote: Verification completes in <30 seconds per customer

requirements.title: False positive rate below 5%
requirements.description: The proportion of valid customers incorrectly flagged by the verification engine must remain below 5%.
requirements.quote: False positive rate <5% (i.e., valid customers incorrectly flagged)

requirements.title: Verification audit log contents
requirements.description: The audit log must record, for each verification check, the timestamp, check type, result and confidence score.
requirements.quote: Audit log captures each verification check: timestamp, check type, result, confidence score

requirements.title: Unverified customers blocked from progressing
requirements.description: Customers who have not passed verification cannot proceed to the next onboarding step; their account remains in "pending verification" status.
requirements.quote: Unverified customers cannot proceed to next step (account remains "pending verification")

requirements.title: External document validation API integration
requirements.description: The system integrates an external Europe-focused document validation API such as IdentityMind or similar.
requirements.quote: Use external API: IdentityMind (Europe-focused) or similar for document validation

requirements.title: API unavailability fallback and retry policy
requirements.description: If the verification API is unavailable, the system retries every 5 minutes up to a maximum of 3 retries and then falls back to manual verification.
requirements.quote: Fallback: Manual verification if API unavailable (retry every 5 minutes, max 3 retries)

requirements.title: 24-hour verification result caching
requirements.description: Verification results are cached for 24 hours on the basis that customer data does not change frequently.
requirements.quote: Performance: Cache verification results for 24 hours (customer data doesn't change frequently)

requirements.title: Automated sanctions and PEP screening before account activation
requirements.description: The system must automatically screen every customer against international sanctions lists and PEP databases prior to account activation, so restricted individuals are not onboarded.
requirements.quote: As a compliance manager, I want to automatically screen customers against international sanctions lists and PEP databases before account activation so that we don't onboard restricted individuals.
requirements.trigger: Customer submits an account application / account creation
requirements.happyPath: Customer record is submitted, the system screens against sanctions and PEP data sources, no match is returned, and the account is activated.

requirements.title: Screening data sources
requirements.description: Screening must draw on the OFAC SDN List, the EU Consolidated Sanctions List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, and the World-Check PEP database (third-party subscription).
requirements.quote: OFAC SDN List (US Office of Foreign Assets Control)

requirements.title: Screening frequency: creation plus weekly re-screening
requirements.description: Screening is performed at account creation and repeated weekly for all active accounts.
requirements.quote: Screening occurs: At account creation + Weekly re-screening for active accounts

requirements.title: Match logic attributes
requirements.description: Screening match logic must compare full name, date of birth and nationality.
requirements.quote: Match logic: Full name + DOB + Nationality

requirements.title: Exact match results in immediate rejection
requirements.description: Where screening produces an exact match, the application is immediately rejected.
requirements.quote: Exact match: Immediate rejection

requirements.title: Fuzzy match above 85% similarity escalates
requirements.description: A high-confidence fuzzy match with greater than 85% similarity must be escalated to compliance review.
requirements.quote: High-confidence fuzzy match (>85% similarity): Escalate to compliance review

requirements.title: Match below 85% confidence is logged and monitored only
requirements.description: Low confidence matches below 85% similarity are logged and monitored, with no escalation raised.
requirements.quote: Low confidence match (<85%): Log and monitor, no escalation

requirements.title: Screening API timeout handling
requirements.description: If the external screening API is unresponsive for more than 30 seconds, account creation is allowed but the case must be flagged for manual review within 2 hours.
requirements.quote: Screening timeout: If external API unresponsive >30 seconds, allow account creation but flag for manual review within 2 hours

requirements.title: Screening latency under 5 seconds
requirements.description: Screening must complete in less than 5 seconds per customer, including network round-trip.
requirements.quote: Screening latency <5 seconds per customer (includes network round-trip)

requirements.title: Zero false negatives in sanctions screening
requirements.description: All actual sanctions matches must be detected; no false negatives are acceptable.
requirements.quote: Zero false negatives (all actual sanctions matches detected)

requirements.title: False positive rate below 2%
requirements.description: Fewer than 2% of legitimate customers may be incorrectly flagged by screening.
requirements.quote: False positive rate <2% (i.e., legitimate customers incorrectly flagged)

requirements.title: Screening audit trail
requirements.description: The audit trail must record screening timestamp, data source version date, match confidence score and analyst action.
requirements.quote: Audit trail: Screening timestamp, data source version date, match confidence score, analyst action

requirements.title: Non-disclosure in rejection notification
requirements.description: Rejected customers receive an automated email with the generic message "Account application not approved"; the sanctions reason must not be disclosed.
requirements.quote: Rejected customers: Automated email with generic "Account application not approved" (do not disclose sanctions reason)

requirements.title: World-Check API integration
requirements.description: Integrate the World-Check API for realtime screening plus nightly bulk re-screening.
requirements.quote: World-Check API: Realtime screening + bulk re-screening nightly

requirements.title: Fallback static sanctions lists
requirements.description: If the screening API is unavailable, the system falls back to static OFAC/EU lists that are updated monthly.
requirements.quote: Fallback list: Static OFAC/EU lists updated monthly if API unavailable

requirements.title: Automatic enhanced due diligence on PEP identification
requirements.description: When a PEP is identified, enhanced due diligence controls are triggered automatically without manual oversight.
requirements.quote: As a senior compliance officer, I want enhanced due diligence triggered automatically when a PEP is identified so that we apply appropriate controls without manual oversight.
requirements.trigger: A PEP match is detected during screening
requirements.happyPath: Screening flags a PEP, the account is set to Pending PEP Review, an escalation task is created for a senior analyst, business rationale is documented and the account is approved with enhanced monitoring.

requirements.title: PEP definition scope
requirements.description: A PEP is defined as government officials in the top 5 ranks, plus their immediate family and known close associates.
requirements.quote: PEP definition: Government officials in top 5 ranks + immediate family + known close associates

requirements.title: Family member screening
requirements.description: Screening covers the customer name plus family members, based on surname matches from the application.
requirements.quote: Screening includes: Customer name + family member screening (surname matches from application)

requirements.title: PEP match sets account to Pending PEP Review
requirements.description: A PEP match automatically sets the account status to "Pending PEP Review".
requirements.quote: Automatic account status: "Pending PEP Review"

requirements.title: PEP escalation task to senior analyst
requirements.description: A PEP match creates a task in the compliance queue assigned to a senior analyst.
requirements.quote: Escalation: Create task in compliance queue (assigned to senior analyst)

requirements.title: Documented business rationale before PEP account activation
requirements.description: A documented business rationale is required before a PEP-flagged account may be activated.
requirements.quote: Requires: Documented business rationale before account activation

requirements.title: Monthly enhanced monitoring for PEPs
requirements.description: PEP-flagged customers are flagged for monthly review instead of the standard quarterly review.
requirements.quote: Enhanced monitoring: Flag for monthly review instead of quarterly

requirements.title: Quarterly PEP re-screening
requirements.description: Customers are re-screened quarterly against updated PEP databases.
requirements.quote: PEP re-screening: Quarterly check against updated PEP databases

requirements.title: PEP identification occurs at account creation
requirements.description: PEP identification must take place at the point of account creation.
requirements.quote: PEP identification at account creation

requirements.title: Escalation task created within 60 seconds
requirements.description: The escalation task must be created within 60 seconds of PEP detection.
requirements.quote: Escalation task created within 60 seconds of detection

requirements.title: System enforces activation block pending compliance approval
requirements.description: A PEP-flagged account cannot be activated until compliance approval is given, and the system enforces this block.
requirements.quote: Account cannot activate until compliance approval (system enforces)

requirements.title: PEP audit trail contents
requirements.description: The audit trail must capture PEP match details, source database, approval decision and approver name.
requirements.quote: Audit trail: PEP match details, source database, approval decision, approver name

requirements.title: Automated risk scoring engine using explainable weighted decision tree
requirements.description: The system must generate a customer risk score using a weighted decision tree algorithm that is explainable, recommending a CDD level (Standard/Enhanced/Simplified) proportionate to customer risk.
requirements.quote: Risk scoring algorithm: Weighted decision tree (explainable)

requirements.title: Risk analyst obtains system-generated risk score and CDD recommendation
requirements.description: A risk analyst completes a customer profile and receives a system-generated risk score with a recommended CDD level so that due diligence is proportionate to customer risk.
requirements.quote: As a risk analyst, I want a system-generated risk score that recommends CDD level (Standard/Enhanced/Simplified) so that we apply appropriate due diligence proportionate to customer risk.
requirements.trigger: Customer profile completion
requirements.happyPath: Customer profile is completed, the scoring engine computes a risk score, and the system recommends a CDD level (Standard/Enhanced/Simplified) to the analyst.

requirements.title: Customer profile factors weighted at 40% of risk score
requirements.description: Customer profile factors (age, nationality/residency, PEP status, beneficial ownership) contribute 40% of the total risk score weight.
requirements.quote: Customer profile factors (40% weight):

requirements.title: Age scoring bands
requirements.description: Age scoring: under 18 adds 5 points, 70 and over adds 3 points, and ages 18-70 add 0 points.

requirements.title: Nationality/residency scoring bands
requirements.description: Nationality/residency scoring: high-risk jurisdiction adds 8 points, FATF grey-list adds 5 points, EU/UK adds 0 points.
requirements.quote: Nationality/Residency: High-risk jurisdiction (+8 pts), FATF grey-list (+5 pts), EU/UK (+0 pts)

requirements.title: PEP status scoring bands
requirements.description: PEP status scoring: a PEP adds 15 points, a family member or close associate of a PEP adds 8 points, and no PEP status adds 0 points.
requirements.quote: PEP Status: PEP (+15 pts), Family/Associate of PEP (+8 pts), None (+0 pts)

requirements.title: Beneficial ownership complexity scoring
requirements.description: Beneficial ownership scoring: a complex structure with more than 5 layers adds 6 points; clear ownership adds 0 points.
requirements.quote: Beneficial Ownership: Complex structure >5 layers (+6 pts), Clear ownership (+0 pts)

requirements.title: Business profile factors weighted at 30% of risk score
requirements.description: Business profile factors (declared business, transaction volume, geographic exposure) contribute 30% of the total risk score weight.
requirements.quote: Business profile factors (30% weight):

requirements.title: Declared business type scoring bands
requirements.description: Declared business scoring: trade finance adds 6 points, real estate/casinos add 5 points, standard business adds 0 points.
requirements.quote: Declared business: Trade finance (+6 pts), Real estate/casinos (+5 pts), Standard (+0 pts)

requirements.title: Transaction volume scoring bands
requirements.description: Transaction volume scoring: more than $5M per year adds 8 points, $500K-$5M adds 4 points, under $500K adds 0 points.
requirements.quote: Transaction volume: >$5M/year (+8 pts), $500K-$5M (+4 pts), <$500K (+0 pts)

requirements.title: Geographic exposure scoring bands
requirements.description: Geographic exposure scoring: exposure to high-risk countries adds 5-8 points; EU-only exposure adds 0 points.
requirements.quote: Geographic exposure: High-risk countries (+5-8 pts), EU only (+0 pts)

requirements.title: Behavioral factors weighted at 30% of risk score
requirements.description: Behavioral factors (documentation completeness, sanctions/PEP matches, previous AML flags) contribute 30% of the total risk score weight.
requirements.quote: Behavioral factors (30% weight):

requirements.title: Documentation completeness scoring
requirements.description: Documentation completeness scoring: missing or incomplete documentation adds 4 points; complete documentation adds 0 points.
requirements.quote: Documentation completeness: Missing/incomplete (+4 pts), Complete (+0 pts)

requirements.title: Sanctions/PEP match history scoring
requirements.description: Sanctions/PEP match scoring: any match history adds 10 points; a clean record adds 0 points.
requirements.quote: Sanctions/PEP matches: Any match history (+10 pts), Clean (+0 pts)

requirements.title: Previous AML flags scoring
requirements.description: Previous AML flags scoring: previous AML flags add 8 points; no prior flags add 0 points.
requirements.quote: Previous AML flags: Yes (+8 pts), No (+0 pts)

requirements.title: Risk score range is 0-100
requirements.description: The computed risk score must fall within a range of 0 to 100.
requirements.quote: Score range: 0-100

requirements.title: Scores 0-25 map to Standard CDD
requirements.description: A risk score between 0 and 25 results in Standard CDD.
requirements.quote: 0-25: Standard CDD

requirements.title: Scores 26-60 map to Medium CDD with quarterly monitoring
requirements.description: A risk score between 26 and 60 results in Medium CDD with enhanced quarterly monitoring.
requirements.quote: 26-60: Medium CDD (enhanced quarterly monitoring)

requirements.title: Scores 61-100 map to Enhanced CDD with monthly monitoring and senior review
requirements.description: A risk score between 61 and 100 results in Enhanced CDD, requiring monthly monitoring plus senior review.
requirements.quote: 61-100: Enhanced CDD (monthly monitoring + senior review)

requirements.title: Risk score is advisory and overridable by compliance officer
requirements.description: The risk score is a recommendation only; a compliance officer retains authority to override it.
requirements.quote: Risk score is recommendation only; compliance officer can override

requirements.title: Risk score computed within 5 seconds
requirements.description: The risk score must be calculated within 5 seconds of customer profile completion.
requirements.quote: Score calculated within 5 seconds of customer profile completion

requirements.title: All scoring factors displayed with rationale
requirements.description: Every scoring factor used in the calculation must be displayed to the compliance team together with its rationale.
requirements.quote: All scoring factors displayed to compliance team with rationale

requirements.title: Risk score override logged with reason
requirements.description: A compliance officer can adjust the risk score, and the override must be logged with a reason.
requirements.quote: Risk score adjustable by compliance officer (override logged with reason)

requirements.title: Quarterly recalculation of risk score
requirements.description: The risk score must be recalculated quarterly, or whenever the customer profile changes.
requirements.quote: Score recalculated quarterly (or on customer profile change)
requirements.trigger: Quarterly schedule or customer profile change

requirements.title: Risk scoring audit trail
requirements.description: The system must record an audit trail containing risk score version, calculation timestamp, factors used, and any manual overrides.
requirements.quote: Audit trail: Risk score version, calculation timestamp, factors used, any manual overrides

requirements.title: Scoring logic stored in configurable rules engine
requirements.description: Scoring logic must be held in a rules engine that is configurable rather than hard-coded.
requirements.quote: Store scoring logic in rules engine (configurable, not hard-coded)

requirements.title: Score versioning history maintained for regulatory audit
requirements.description: When business rules change, the system must maintain a history of scoring versions because regulators may audit them.
requirements.quote: Score versioning: When business rules change, maintain history (regulators may audit)

requirements.title: Model must be fully explainable to compliance team
requirements.description: Any AI/model used in scoring must be fully explainable, such that the compliance team can understand every point awarded.
requirements.quote: AI considerations: Model must be fully explainable; compliance team must understand every point

requirements.title: Automatic CDD level assignment from risk score
requirements.description: The system automatically assigns the CDD level based on the calculated risk score.
requirements.quote: System automatically assigns CDD level based on risk score

requirements.title: Compliance officer reviews and confirms assigned CDD level
requirements.description: A compliance officer relies on automatic CDD level assignment so that manual review effort is focused on high-risk cases, and can change the assignment with a documented reason.
requirements.quote: As a compliance officer, I want the CDD level automatically assigned based on risk score so that I can focus manual review only on high-risk cases.
requirements.trigger: Risk score calculated for a customer
requirements.happyPath: The system assigns a CDD level from the risk score; the compliance officer reviews it and either accepts it or changes it with a documented reason, and the change is logged.

requirements.title: CDD level assignment is a recommendation that can be changed with documented reason
requirements.description: The automatically assigned CDD level is a recommendation; an officer can change it provided a reason is documented.
requirements.quote: Assignment is recommendation; officer can change with documented reason

requirements.title: CDD level drives required documentation checklist
requirements.description: The assigned CDD level determines the required documentation checklist for the customer.
requirements.quote: Required documentation checklist

requirements.title: CDD level drives monitoring frequency
requirements.description: The assigned CDD level determines monitoring frequency, either quarterly or monthly.
requirements.quote: Monitoring frequency (quarterly/monthly)

requirements.title: CDD level drives escalation authority
requirements.description: The assigned CDD level determines escalation authority: standard review versus senior review.
requirements.quote: Escalation authority (standard review vs. senior review)

requirements.title: Approval timelines by review type
requirements.description: Approval timelines depend on review type: standard review must complete within 24 hours; enhanced review within 48-72 hours.
requirements.quote: Approval timeline (standard review: 24 hours; enhanced: 48-72 hours)

requirements.title: Customer profile displays CDD level and reason
requirements.description: The customer profile must display the current CDD level along with the reason for that level.
requirements.quote: Customer profile displays current CDD level and reason

requirements.title: CDD level assigned before customer proceeds
requirements.description: A CDD level must be assigned before the customer can move to the next step of the process.
requirements.quote: CDD level assigned before customer can proceed to next step

requirements.title: CDD level changes logged
requirements.description: A compliance officer can change the CDD level assignment and the change must be logged.
requirements.quote: Compliance officer can change assignment (change logged)

requirements.title: No customer may have unknown CDD level
requirements.description: Every customer must be assigned a CDD level; an "unknown" status is not permitted.
requirements.quote: All customers assigned a level (no "unknown" status)

requirements.title: CDD assignment audit trail
requirements.description: The system must record the initial CDD level assignment, any changes, timestamps, and the reason for each change.
requirements.quote: Audit trail: Initial assignment, any changes, timestamp, reason for change

requirements.title: Dynamic document checklist driven by CDD level
requirements.description: The system generates the required document checklist automatically from the customer's assigned CDD level so agents only request documents relevant to that level.
requirements.quote: Checklist generated based on CDD level:

requirements.title: Onboarding agent uses checklist to collect customer documents
requirements.description: A customer onboarding agent is shown the system-determined document list for the customer's CDD level, avoiding requests for unnecessary documents.
requirements.quote: As a customer onboarding agent, I want the system to tell me which documents the customer must provide based on their CDD level so that customers aren't asked for unnecessary documents.
requirements.trigger: Customer is assigned a CDD level during onboarding
requirements.happyPath: System determines CDD level, generates the matching document checklist, agent collects and submits only the listed documents, all items are verified and the customer advances.

requirements.title: Standard CDD document set
requirements.description: Customers at Standard CDD level must provide a government ID and proof of address.
requirements.quote: **Standard CDD:** Government ID + Proof of address

requirements.title: Medium CDD document set
requirements.description: Customers at Medium CDD level must provide a government ID, proof of address and a source of funds declaration.
requirements.quote: **Medium CDD:** Gov ID + Proof of address + Source of funds declaration

requirements.title: Enhanced CDD document set
requirements.description: Customers at Enhanced CDD level must provide a government ID, proof of address, source of funds, beneficial ownership documentation and a business rationale.
requirements.quote: **Enhanced CDD:** Gov ID + Proof of address + Source of funds + Beneficial ownership documentation + Business rationale

requirements.title: Simplified CDD document set
requirements.description: Where Simplified CDD applies, only an ID document is required and no proof of address is needed.
requirements.quote: **Simplified CDD (where applicable):** ID only (no proof of address required)

requirements.title: Checklist visible in customer onboarding portal
requirements.description: The generated document checklist is displayed to the customer within the onboarding portal.
requirements.quote: Checklist displays to customer in onboarding portal

requirements.title: Document status tracking states
requirements.description: Each document is tracked through the statuses Pending, Received, Verified, Rejected and Re-submission Required.
requirements.quote: Document status tracking: Pending, Received, Verified, Rejected, Re-submission Required

requirements.title: Auto-progress when all checklist items verified
requirements.description: Once every checklist item is marked "Verified", the customer is automatically advanced to the next onboarding step.
requirements.quote: Auto-progress: Once all checklist items marked "Verified", customer advances to next step

requirements.title: Re-submission workflow with rejection reasons
requirements.description: Rejected documents trigger a customer notification that states the specific reason for rejection.
requirements.quote: Re-submission workflow: Rejected documents trigger customer notification with specific reasons

requirements.title: Proof of address recency limit
requirements.description: A proof of address document must be dated within the last 3 months, otherwise it is rejected as too old.
requirements.quote: "Proof of address too old - must be dated within 3 months"

requirements.title: Checklist correctness for CDD level
requirements.description: The system must generate the correct document checklist matching the customer's CDD level.
requirements.quote: Correct checklist generated for customer's CDD level

requirements.title: Human verification required before verified status
requirements.description: No document may be marked as verified until a compliance analyst confirms it.
requirements.quote: No documents marked verified until compliance analyst confirms

requirements.title: Email notification on every document status change
requirements.description: The customer receives an email notification for each document status change, including rejection, re-submission received and all documents verified.
requirements.quote: Customer receives email notification for each status change (document rejected, re-submission received, all docs verified)

requirements.title: Manual document requests by compliance analyst
requirements.description: A compliance analyst can add ad-hoc document requests to a customer's checklist, such as requesting bank statements for the last 3 months.
requirements.quote: Compliance analyst can add manual document requests ("Please provide bank statements for last 3 months")

requirements.title: Audit trail for document handling
requirements.description: The system records document status changes, analyst notes and upload/verification timestamps in an audit trail.
requirements.quote: Audit trail: Document status changes, analyst notes, upload/verification timestamps

requirements.title: Eight-state account status model
requirements.description: The system must support eight defined account statuses across the onboarding lifecycle: Pending CIV, Pending Screening, Pending CDD Review, Pending Document Collection, Pending Compliance Approval, Active, Rejected, and On Hold.
requirements.quote: 1. "Pending CIV" - Awaiting ID/address verification
