requirements.title: Automated status transitions through verification and screening
requirements.description: Status must advance automatically from Pending CIV to Pending Screening when the ID is verified, and from Pending Screening to Pending CDD Review when screening completes.
requirements.quote: Automated: Pending CIV → Pending Screening (when ID verified) → Pending CDD Review (when screening complete)

requirements.title: Manual transition from Pending Compliance Approval
requirements.description: Movement from Pending Compliance Approval to Active or Rejected must be a manual decision made by a compliance officer.
requirements.quote: Manual: Pending Compliance Approval → Active/Rejected (compliance officer decision)

requirements.title: Standard CDD approval SLA of 24 hours
requirements.description: For standard CDD cases, an approval decision must be made within 24 hours of document receipt.
requirements.quote: Standard CDD: Approval decision within 24 hours of document receipt

requirements.title: Enhanced CDD approval SLA of 72 hours
requirements.description: For enhanced CDD cases, an approval decision must be made within 72 hours of document receipt.
requirements.quote: Enhanced CDD: Approval decision within 72 hours of document receipt

requirements.title: No account activation without verification
requirements.description: Regulatory requirement that no account may be activated without verification; there is no fixed time limit, but compliance best practice is 3-5 days.
requirements.quote: Regulatory requirement: No account activation without verification (no time limit, but compliance best practice is 3-5 days)

requirements.title: Flag tasks approaching SLA in compliance queue
requirements.description: When an SLA deadline is approaching, the associated task must be flagged in the compliance queue for escalation.
requirements.quote: Escalation: If SLA approaching, task is flagged in compliance queue

requirements.title: Compliance manager visibility of onboarding progress
requirements.description: A compliance manager needs end-to-end visibility of where each customer sits in the onboarding process and whether regulatory approval timelines are being met, in order to manage workload and ensure compliance.
requirements.quote: As a compliance manager, I want visibility into where each customer is in the onboarding process and whether we're meeting regulatory approval timelines so that I can manage workload and ensure compliance.
requirements.trigger: Compliance manager reviews the onboarding pipeline
requirements.happyPath: Manager opens dashboard, views each customer's account status and SLA countdown, and reallocates workload where deadlines are at risk.

requirements.title: Account status visible in compliance dashboard
requirements.description: Account status must be displayed in the dashboard for the compliance team.
requirements.quote: Account status visible in dashboard for compliance team

requirements.title: SLA countdown timer for open applications
requirements.description: An SLA countdown timer must be displayed for all open applications.
requirements.quote: SLA countdown timer displayed for open applications

requirements.title: Red flag escalation alert within 2 hours of deadline
requirements.description: SLA violations must trigger an escalation alert, with a red flag raised if the deadline falls within 2 hours.
requirements.quote: SLA violations trigger escalation alert (red flag if deadline within 2 hours)

requirements.title: Status change audit trail
requirements.description: Every status change must be recorded with timestamp, status, previous status, who changed it, and a reason where applicable.
requirements.quote: Status change audit trail: Timestamp, status, previous status, changed by, reason (if applicable)

requirements.title: Customer self-service status view without compliance details
requirements.description: Customers must be able to view their application status in a self-service portal, showing only a generic status and not compliance details.
requirements.quote: Customer can view application status in self-service portal (generic status, not compliance details)

requirements.title: Automated transaction screening and monitoring dashboard
requirements.description: The system must automatically screen all customer transactions against monitoring rules and flag those exceeding risk thresholds for analyst review, presented in a monitoring dashboard.
requirements.quote: As a compliance analyst, I want to see all customer transactions screened automatically and flagged for review if they exceed risk thresholds so that I can detect suspicious activity.
requirements.trigger: Customer transaction posted
requirements.happyPath: Transaction is posted, screened against monitoring rules, flagged if a threshold is breached, surfaced on the monitoring dashboard sorted by risk score, and reviewed by the analyst.

requirements.title: Single transaction above €10,000 for high-risk customer
requirements.description: A single transaction exceeding €10,000 must be logged and flagged for review when the customer is classified as high-risk.
requirements.quote: Single transaction >€10,000: Log + flag for review if customer is high-risk

requirements.title: Cumulative monthly volume above €50,000
requirements.description: Cumulative transaction value exceeding €50,000 in a month must be flagged for review.
requirements.quote: Cumulative monthly >€50,000: Flag for review

requirements.title: Rapid in/out flow structuring rule
requirements.description: Transactions showing more than €5K in and less than €100 out within 24 hours must be flagged as potential structuring.
requirements.quote: Rapid in/out flows (>€5K in, <€100 out within 24 hours): Potential structuring, flag

requirements.title: Geographic anomaly flag
requirements.description: A transaction to a high-risk country that is not part of the customer's profile must be flagged.
requirements.quote: Geographic anomaly: Transaction to high-risk country not in customer's profile: Flag

requirements.title: High transaction frequency flag
requirements.description: More than 100 transactions per day must be flagged; the threshold must be configurable.
requirements.quote: High transaction frequency: >100 transactions/day (threshold configurable): Flag

requirements.title: Monitoring dashboard content
requirements.description: The monitoring dashboard must display flagged transactions auto-sorted by risk score, customer transaction history for the last 30/90/365 days, transaction pattern comparison of baseline versus current, and analyst action tracking (reviewed, approved, escalated to SAR).
requirements.quote: Flagged transactions (auto-sorted by risk score)

requirements.title: SAR creation from suspicious transaction
requirements.description: When an officer marks a transaction as "Suspicious", the system must create a SAR with a template auto-populated with transaction details.
requirements.quote: Officer marks transaction as "Suspicious" → Creates SAR
requirements.trigger: Transaction marked as Suspicious
requirements.happyPath: Officer marks the transaction suspicious, a SAR is created with auto-populated transaction details, submitted to the FIU, and the filing confirmation is logged.

requirements.title: SAR submission to FIU within required timeframe
requirements.description: Suspicious Activity Reports must be submitted to the Financial Intelligence Unit within the required regulatory timeframe, and the filing confirmation must be logged.
requirements.quote: SAR submitted to Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) within required timeframe

requirements.title: Transaction flagged within 30 seconds
requirements.description: A transaction must be flagged within 30 seconds of posting.
requirements.quote: Transaction flagged within 30 seconds of posting

requirements.title: Flagged transactions display risk reason
requirements.description: The dashboard must show all flagged transactions together with the reason they were flagged.
requirements.quote: Dashboard shows all flagged transactions with risk reason

requirements.title: Analyst manual notes on reviews
requirements.description: An analyst must be able to add manual notes to a flagged transaction review.
requirements.quote: Analyst can add manual notes ("Customer confirmed legitimate business travel")

requirements.title: False positive rate below 10%
requirements.description: The transaction monitoring false positive rate — legitimate transactions sent for review — must be less than 10%.
requirements.quote: False positive rate <10% (i.e., legitimate transactions reviewed)

requirements.title: SAR filing auditability
requirements.description: SAR filings must be auditable, recording timestamp, FIU reference number and contents.
requirements.quote: SAR filing auditable (timestamp, FIU reference number, contents)

requirements.title: Scheduled periodic customer risk review
requirements.description: The system must schedule periodic customer reviews so that ongoing monitoring is maintained and risk is re-assessed as customers age in the portfolio.
requirements.quote: As a compliance officer, I want the system to schedule periodic customer reviews so that we maintain ongoing monitoring and re-assess risk as customers age in portfolio.
requirements.trigger: Review due date reached
requirements.happyPath: The system schedules a review based on risk level, notifies the assigned analyst, the analyst completes the review checklist and records an action, and the outcome is documented in the audit trail.

requirements.title: Standard CDD review frequency
requirements.description: Customers subject to Standard CDD must be reviewed quarterly.
requirements.quote: Standard CDD: Quarterly review

requirements.title: Medium CDD review frequency
requirements.description: Customers subject to Medium CDD must be reviewed bi-weekly.
requirements.quote: Medium CDD: Bi-weekly reviews

requirements.title: Enhanced CDD review frequency
requirements.description: Customers subject to Enhanced CDD must be reviewed monthly.
requirements.quote: Enhanced CDD: Monthly reviews

requirements.title: Automated review due notification to assigned analyst
requirements.description: When a review is scheduled, the system must send an automated email to the assigned analyst stating the customer review is due.
requirements.quote: Automated email to assigned analyst: "Customer review due: [Customer Name]"

requirements.title: Periodic review checklist
requirements.description: The review must present a checklist covering transaction activity summary, any flags, risk profile changes and continued relationship justification.
requirements.quote: Review checklist: Transaction activity summary, any flags, risk profile changes, continued relationship justification

requirements.title: Review action options
requirements.description: On completing a review the analyst must be able to select one of the actions: Accept (no changes), Update risk score, Escalate to senior review, or Close account.
requirements.quote: Review action: Accept (no changes), Update risk score, Escalate to senior review, Close account

requirements.title: Profile change triggers immediate risk re-assessment
requirements.description: A change to a customer's business type, occupation or beneficial ownership must trigger an immediate risk re-assessment.
requirements.quote: If customer changes business type, occupation, beneficial ownership → Immediate risk re-assessment

requirements.title: Sanctions hit during monitoring triggers freeze and SAR
requirements.description: If a customer becomes sanctioned during ongoing monitoring, the account must be immediately frozen and a SAR filed.
requirements.quote: If customer sanctioned during monitoring → Immediate account freeze + SAR filing

requirements.title: Review notification lead time
requirements.description: Review notifications must be sent 5 days before the review due date.
requirements.quote: Review notifications sent 5 days before due date

requirements.title: Reviews cannot be dismissed
requirements.description: A compliance analyst must not be able to dismiss a scheduled review; it must be completed or escalated.
requirements.quote: Compliance analyst cannot dismiss review (must complete or escalate)

requirements.title: Reviews documented with comments and approval
requirements.description: All reviews must be documented with analyst comments and approval.
requirements.quote: All reviews documented with analyst comments and approval

requirements.title: Re-assessment completed within 24 hours of profile change
requirements.description: Profile changes must trigger an automated risk re-assessment within 24 hours.
requirements.quote: Profile changes trigger automated re-assessment within 24 hours

requirements.title: Periodic review audit trail
requirements.description: The system must maintain an audit trail of each review recording the completed date, findings, action taken and approver.
requirements.quote: Audit trail: Review completed date, findings, action taken, approver

requirements.title: Page load time under 3 seconds
requirements.description: Dashboard and customer search pages must load in less than 3 seconds.
requirements.quote: Page load time: <3 seconds (dashboard, customer search)

requirements.title: Transaction flagging within 30 seconds
requirements.description: A transaction must be flagged within 30 seconds of the transaction being posted.
requirements.quote: Transaction flagging: <30 seconds from transaction posting

requirements.title: Screening response under 5 seconds per customer
requirements.description: Screening must return a response in less than 5 seconds for each customer screened.
requirements.quote: Screening response: <5 seconds per customer

requirements.title: Support 50 concurrent compliance analysts
requirements.description: The system must support a minimum of 50 concurrent compliance analyst users.
requirements.quote: Concurrent users: Support 50 concurrent compliance analysts minimum

requirements.title: Data encryption at rest and in transit
requirements.description: Data must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
requirements.quote: Data encryption: At-rest (AES-256), in-transit (TLS 1.2+)

requirements.title: Role-based access control
requirements.description: Access to the system must be controlled by roles: analyst, compliance officer, and admin.
requirements.quote: Access control: Role-based (analyst, compliance officer, admin)

requirements.title: Audit logging of all user actions
requirements.description: All user actions — view, update and export — must be logged with a timestamp and user ID.
requirements.quote: Audit logging: All user actions logged (view, update, export) with timestamp + user ID

requirements.title: Retain data 5 years post-account closure
requirements.description: Customer data must be retained for 5 years after account closure, as a regulatory requirement.
requirements.quote: Data retention: 5 years post-account closure (regulatory requirement)

requirements.title: Mask sensitive PII fields in the UI
requirements.description: Sensitive fields such as ID number and date of birth must be masked in the UI unless the analyst has explicit permission to view them.
requirements.quote: PII handling: Sensitive fields (ID number, DOB) masked in UI unless analyst has explicit permission

requirements.title: GDPR customer data deletion on account closure
requirements.description: Customer data deletion must be available upon account closure, with the audit trail excluded from deletion.
requirements.quote: GDPR compliance: Customer data deletion available upon account closure (except audit trail)

requirements.title: Built-in SAR/CTR reporting templates with FIU submission tracking
requirements.description: The system must provide built-in templates for Suspicious Activity Reports and Currency Transaction Reports, and track submissions to the Financial Intelligence Unit.
requirements.quote: Regulatory reporting: Built-in SAR/CTR templates + FIU submission tracking

requirements.title: Audit trail for all decisions
requirements.description: Every decision must be logged in an audit trail capturing timestamp, the user responsible, and the rationale for the decision.
requirements.quote: Audit trail: All decisions logged with timestamp, user, and rationale

requirements.title: 10-day retrieval SLA for regulator document requests
requirements.description: Documents must be held in digital storage and be retrievable within 10 days of a regulator request.
requirements.quote: Document retention: Digital storage with 10-day retrieval SLA for regulator requests

requirements.title: Automated decisions must be explainable to compliance
requirements.description: All automated decisions, including risk scoring and screening outcomes, must be explainable to the compliance team.
requirements.quote: Explainability: All automated decisions (risk scoring, screening) must be explainable to compliance team

requirements.title: EU AI Act transparency requirements for ML/AI models
requirements.description: Where machine learning or AI is used to make decisions, the model must meet the transparency requirements of the EU AI Act.
requirements.quote: EU AI Act: If ML/AI used for decisions, model must meet transparency requirements

requirements.title: PostgreSQL datastore indexed for compliance queries
requirements.description: The system must use PostgreSQL as its database, optimized for compliance queries with indexes on customer ID, transaction date, and risk score.
requirements.quote: Database: PostgreSQL, optimized for compliance queries (indexed on customer ID, transaction date, risk score)

requirements.title: Redis caching of screening data
requirements.description: Screening data must be cached in Redis to support fast sanctions/watchlist screening.
requirements.quote: Caching: Redis for screening data (OFAC lists cached, refreshed hourly)

requirements.title: OFAC list cache refreshed hourly
requirements.description: Cached OFAC list data must be refreshed on an hourly cycle so screening runs against current list content.
requirements.quote: OFAC lists cached, refreshed hourly

requirements.title: Archive data older than two years to cold storage
requirements.description: Historical data more than 2 years old must be archived to cold storage for cost optimization.
requirements.quote: Archival: Historical data (>2 years old) archived to cold storage (cost optimization)

requirements.title: Onboarding completed in under 2 hours for standard customers
requirements.description: Standard customer onboarding must complete in less than 2 hours, measured by timestamp from application start to account active.
requirements.quote: | Onboarding completion time | <2 hours for standard customers | Timestamp from application start to account active |

requirements.title: 80% of standard cases auto-approved
requirements.description: At least 80% of standard cases must be auto-approved, measured as cases marked "Approved" without manual escalation.
requirements.quote: | Manual review reduction | 80% of standard cases auto-approved | Cases marked "Approved" without manual escalation |

requirements.title: OCR accuracy above 95% and false rejections under 5%
requirements.description: Document verification must achieve greater than 95% OCR accuracy and less than 5% false rejections.
requirements.quote: | Verification accuracy | >95% OCR accuracy, <5% false rejections | Audit sample: 100 random documents per month |

requirements.title: Monthly audit sample of 100 documents for verification accuracy
requirements.description: Verification accuracy must be measured through an audit sample of 100 random documents per month.
requirements.quote: Audit sample: 100 random documents per month

requirements.title: 100% of applications reviewed within SLA
requirements.description: All applications must be reviewed within the compliance SLA, with cases within/outside SLA tracked daily.
requirements.quote: | Compliance SLA | 100% of applications reviewed within SLA | Cases within/outside SLA tracked daily |

requirements.title: Screening false positive rate below 2%
requirements.description: The screening false positive rate must stay below 2%, calculated as cases flagged but later cleared divided by total screening matches.
requirements.quote: | False positive rate (screening) | <2% | Cases flagged but later cleared / total screening matches |

requirements.title: 100% of decisions logged in audit trail
requirements.description: Every decision must be logged to the audit trail, verified via random audits of 20 cases per month.
requirements.quote: | Audit trail completeness | 100% of decisions logged | Random audits of 20 cases per month |

requirements.title: Phase 1 (MVP) delivery scope
requirements.description: The MVP release must deliver core customer onboarding, screening and risk assessment capabilities as the first phase of the rollout.
requirements.quote: **Phase 1 (MVP):** Core onboarding + screening + risk assessment

requirements.title: Phase 2 delivery scope – advanced monitoring and behavioral analytics
requirements.description: The second rollout phase must add advanced monitoring and behavioral analytics on top of the MVP capabilities.
requirements.quote: **Phase 2:** Advanced monitoring + behavioral analytics

requirements.title: Phase 3 delivery scope – biometric, video identity and fraud detection
requirements.description: The third rollout phase must add biometric verification, video identity verification and advanced fraud detection.
requirements.quote: **Phase 3:** Biometric verification + video identity + advanced fraud detection

requirements.title: Phase 4 delivery scope – predictive risk modeling and third-party data
requirements.description: The fourth rollout phase must add predictive risk modeling and integrated third-party data services.
requirements.quote: **Phase 4:** Predictive risk modeling + integrated third-party data services

requirements.title: Compliance with FATF Recommendation 10 (Customer Due Diligence)
requirements.description: The system must satisfy the customer due diligence obligations set out in FATF Recommendation 10.
requirements.quote: **FATF Recommendation 10:** Customer Due Diligence

requirements.title: Compliance with AML5 Article 13 (Customer Due Diligence)
requirements.description: The system must meet the customer due diligence requirements of Article 13 of the EU AML5 Directive.
requirements.quote: **AML5 Directive (EU):** Article 13 (CDD), Article 15 (Enhanced CDD)

requirements.title: Compliance with AML5 Article 15 (Enhanced Customer Due Diligence)
requirements.description: The system must meet the enhanced customer due diligence requirements of Article 15 of the EU AML5 Directive.
requirements.quote: **AML5 Directive (EU):** Article 13 (CDD), Article 15 (Enhanced CDD)

requirements.title: Compliance with PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication and fraud prevention
requirements.description: The system must comply with PSD2 (EU) requirements for Strong Customer Authentication and fraud prevention.
requirements.quote: **PSD2 (EU):** Strong Customer Authentication + Fraud Prevention

requirements.title: Compliance with MiFID II customer knowledge requirements
requirements.description: The system must satisfy MiFID II customer knowledge requirements.
requirements.quote: **MiFID II:** Customer knowledge requirements

requirements.title: Alignment with Wolfsberg customer risk rating and due diligence standards
requirements.description: The system must align with Wolfsberg Group standards for customer risk rating and due diligence.
requirements.quote: **Wolfsberg:** Customer Risk Rating & Due Diligence Standards

requirements.title: EU AI Act transparency and explainability for high-risk AI decisions
requirements.description: AI-driven decisions classified as high-risk must meet EU AI Act obligations for transparency and explainability.
requirements.quote: **EU AI Act:** Transparency, explainability for high-risk AI decisions

requirements.title: Compliance approach subject to legal review before regulatory acceptance
requirements.description: The programme assumes authorities will accept the described KYC/AML approach as compliant, with that assumption held open pending legal review. Regulatory acceptance must be confirmed via legal review before the approach is treated as approved.
requirements.quote: Regulatory approval timeline: Authorities will accept this approach as compliant (assume yes pending legal review)

requirements.title: Sanctions screening APIs available in all target jurisdictions
requirements.description: The design assumes third-party sanctions screening APIs are available in every target jurisdiction. The solution depends on this availability, and the assumption must be validated per jurisdiction.
requirements.quote: Third-party API availability: Assume sanctions screening APIs available in all target jurisdictions

requirements.title: Customer data quality planning assumption: 70% first-time correct
requirements.description: Capacity and process planning assumes 70% of customers provide correct information on first submission, with the remaining 30% requiring re-submission of information.
requirements.quote: Customer data quality: Assume 70% of customers provide correct information initially (30% require re-submission)

requirements.title: Document language support limited to English and German for MVP
requirements.description: Whether multi-language document support is needed is an open question; the working assumption is that only English and German documents are supported in the MVP.
requirements.quote: Do we need to support multiple languages for documents? (Assume English/German initially for MVP)

requirements.title: Video identity verification scope decision (MVP vs Phase 2)
requirements.description: An open business/product decision is required on whether video identity verification is delivered in the MVP or deferred to Phase 2.
requirements.quote: Should we support video identity verification in MVP or Phase 2? (Business/Product decision)

requirements.title: Approved SAR filing process to be confirmed with compliance legal team
requirements.description: The approved process for filing Suspicious Activity Reports is not yet defined and must be confirmed with the compliance legal team before implementation.
requirements.quote: What's the approved process for SAR filing? (Confirm with compliance legal team)

requirements.title: Clarify regulator pre-approval or submission of risk scoring algorithm
requirements.description: It is unresolved whether regulators will pre-approve the risk scoring algorithm or whether it must be submitted to them; resolution is pending legal review.
requirements.quote: Will regulators pre-approve our risk scoring algorithm or do we need to submit it? (Pending legal review)

requirements.title: Multi-jurisdiction coverage for SME trade finance customers
requirements.description: The digital platform must support onboarding and servicing of SME importers/exporters across 12 EU countries plus the UK, Switzerland, and Turkey, covering both EU and non-EU jurisdictions.
requirements.quote: implementing a new digital platform to serve SME importers/exporters across 12 EU countries plus UK, Switzerland, and Turkey

requirements.title: Rapid KYC onboarding with AML/CFT controls
requirements.description: The platform must enable rapid KYC onboarding for international traders while simultaneously enforcing strict AML/CFT controls, so speed of onboarding does not weaken financial crime prevention.
requirements.quote: The platform must enable rapid KYC onboarding for international traders while enforcing strict AML/CFT controls.

requirements.title: Onboarding completed in under 24 hours
requirements.description: Onboarding turnaround must be reduced from the current manual process of 5-7 days to less than 24 hours.
requirements.quote: Current manual process takes 5-7 days; target is <24 hours.

requirements.title: Requirements traceable to customer base, regulation and operations
requirements.description: Business requirements for the platform must be derived from ETFB's customer base, regulatory environment, and operational constraints.
requirements.quote: This document outlines business requirements derived from ETFB's customer base, regulatory environment, and operational constraints.

requirements.title: Operate under EU banking directive and national prudential supervision
requirements.description: ETFB is licensed under the EU banking directive and supervised by a national prudential regulator, so all KYC/AML controls must satisfy both EU-level and national prudential requirements.
requirements.quote: Licensed: EU banking directive + national prudential regulator

requirements.title: Comply with AML5, PSD2, MiFID II and national regulations
requirements.description: The compliance framework the bank must operate within comprises AML5 (EU), PSD2 for payments, MiFID II for investment services, and applicable national regulations.
requirements.quote: Compliance framework: AML5 (EU), PSD2 (payments), MiFID II (investment services), national regulations

requirements.title: Meet OFAC requirements for correspondent banking with US banks
requirements.description: Because the bank has significant correspondent banking activity with US banks, its sanctions and screening controls must meet OFAC requirements.
requirements.quote: Correspondent banking: Significant activity with US banks (must meet OFAC requirements)

requirements.title: Demonstrate robust AML/KYC for the 2025 FATF mutual evaluation
requirements.description: A FATF mutual evaluation is scheduled for 2025; the bank must be able to demonstrate robust AML/KYC controls in advance of it.
requirements.quote: FATF mutual evaluation scheduled: 2025 - need to demonstrate robust AML/KYC

requirements.title: Re-screen customers when the EU High-Risk Jurisdiction list is updated
requirements.description: The EU High-Risk Jurisdiction list is updated regularly, and each update requires re-screening of affected customers.
requirements.quote: EU High-Risk Jurisdiction list: Regular updates requiring re-screening

requirements.title: Treat Iran, North Korea, Syria and Russia as sanctions exposure routes
requirements.description: The bank's identified sanctions exposure covers Iran, North Korea, Syria and Russia, which are high-risk trade routes and must be handled accordingly in screening and risk assessment.
requirements.quote: Sanctions exposure: Iran, North Korea, Syria, Russia (high-risk trade routes)

requirements.title: Medium-high risk appetite reflecting cross-border trade finance
requirements.description: The bank's stated risk appetite is medium-high, on the basis that trade finance is inherently cross-border; risk decisioning must align to this appetite.
requirements.quote: Risk appetite: Medium-high (trade finance inherently cross-border)

requirements.title: Support defined customer segments: SMEs, multinational corporates and traders
requirements.description: Customer base comprises SMEs of 50-5000 employees, multinational corporates of 2000+ employees, and traders; the KYC solution must support these segments.
requirements.quote: Customers: SMEs (50-5000 employees), multinational corporates (2000+ employees), traders

requirements.title: Support geographic footprint across EU, UK, Switzerland, Turkey and emerging markets
requirements.description: The bank's geographic focus spans the EU, UK, Switzerland, Turkey and emerging markets, which defines the jurisdictional scope for KYC and risk controls.
requirements.quote: Geographic focus: EU, UK, Switzerland, Turkey, emerging markets

requirements.title: Maintain mature compliance function with annual external audit
requirements.description: Compliance maturity is mature, evidenced by an annual external audit and an internal compliance function; controls and records must be auditable to that standard.
requirements.quote: Compliance maturity: Mature (annual external audit, internal compliance function)

requirements.title: Standard CDD for low-complexity domestic SME exporters
requirements.description: Customers matching the Domestic SME Exporter persona (domestic ownership, no PEP relationship, no risk factors) are classified as Low KYC complexity and require only standard customer due diligence rather than enhanced due diligence.
requirements.quote: - Standard CDD sufficient

requirements.title: Required onboarding documentation set for domestic SME exporters
requirements.description: Onboarding of a domestic SME exporter must collect four document types: identity document, proof of address, business registration, and a bank reference.
requirements.quote: - Documentation: ID + proof of address + business registration + bank reference

requirements.title: Four-hour approval target for low-complexity customers
requirements.description: The expected end-to-end approval timeline for a Low KYC complexity domestic SME exporter is 4 hours from application to decision.
requirements.quote: - Expected approval timeline: 4 hours

requirements.title: Automated verification completes within two hours
requirements.description: For low-complexity domestic SME exporter applications, the automated verification of submitted documents and data must complete within 2 hours of document upload.
requirements.quote: 3. Automated verification completes within 2 hours

requirements.title: Customer document upload capability
requirements.description: The system must allow the customer to upload onboarding documents, including identity document, company registration and proof of address.
requirements.quote: 2. Customer uploads documents (ID, company registration, proof of address)

requirements.title: Dual channel account request: online or bank representative
requirements.description: A customer must be able to initiate an account request either online (self-service) or via a bank representative.
requirements.quote: 1. Customer requests account online or via bank representative

requirements.title: Five-minute compliance officer review for low-complexity cases
requirements.description: After automated verification succeeds, a compliance officer performs a brief review of approximately 5 minutes to approve the low-complexity domestic SME exporter application.
requirements.quote: 4. Compliance officer approves (5-minute review)

requirements.title: No escalation path for straightforward low-risk domestic SME cases
requirements.description: Domestic SME exporter cases with no risk factors follow a straightforward compliance path and do not require escalation.
requirements.quote: - Compliance story: Straightforward, no escalation

requirements.title: Beneficial ownership capture for domestic SME exporters
requirements.description: For the domestic SME exporter persona, beneficial ownership typically comprises 1 to 5 individuals who are domestic residents, and these must be identified as part of due diligence.
requirements.quote: - Beneficial ownership: Usually 1-5 individuals, domestic residents

requirements.title: Account activation enables first trade transaction
requirements.description: Once the compliance officer approves the application, the account is activated and the customer can submit their first trade transaction.
requirements.quote: 5. Account activated, customer can submit first trade transaction

requirements.title: Domestic SME exporter onboarding journey
requirements.description: A domestic SME exporter (CFO or Trade Manager acting for a 50-200 employee manufacturing or consumer goods exporter with €500K-€3M annual trade) onboards end to end: requests the account, uploads documents, passes automated verification, receives compliance approval and begins trading.
requirements.quote:
**Business Process:**
1. Customer requests account online or via bank representative
requirements.trigger: Customer requests a trade finance account online or via a bank representative
requirements.happyPath: Customer requests the account, uploads ID, company registration and proof of address; automated verification completes within 2 hours; compliance officer approves in a 5-minute review; the account is activated within the 4-hour target and the customer submits a first trade transaction.

requirements.title: Clear source of funds from business sales revenue
requirements.description: For the domestic SME exporter persona, the source of funds is business sales revenue and is treated as clear, requiring no further source-of-funds investigation.
requirements.quote: - Source of funds: Clear (business sales revenue)

requirements.title: Domestic non-PEP ownership as a low-risk indicator
requirements.description: The domestic SME exporter persona has domestic ownership that is not PEP-related, which contributes to the Low KYC complexity classification and no identified risk factors.
requirements.quote: - Ownership: Domestic (not PEP-related)

requirements.title: Medium CDD for international traders
requirements.description: Customers in the international trader/reseller segment must undergo Medium Customer Due Diligence due to their higher transaction volume.
requirements.quote: Medium CDD required (higher transaction volume)

requirements.title: Beneficial ownership capture including non-EU residents
requirements.description: The system must capture beneficial ownership structures of 2-5 individuals for trader customers, supporting owners who may be non-EU residents.
requirements.quote: Beneficial ownership: 2-5 individuals, may include non-EU residents

requirements.title: Documented source of funds for trade financing
requirements.description: Source of funds for traders is clear but must be evidenced with documentation such as import financing or supplier credit.
requirements.quote: Source of funds: Clear but requires documentation (import financing, supplier credit)

requirements.title: Trader risk factors recognised in risk assessment
requirements.description: Risk assessment must account for frequent high-value transactions, rapid in/out flows and multiple jurisdictions as risk factors for this segment.
requirements.quote: Risk factors: Frequent high-value transactions, rapid in/out flows, multiple jurisdictions

requirements.title: Approval within 8-12 hours
requirements.description: Onboarding decisions for international trader customers are expected to complete within 8 to 12 hours.
requirements.quote: Expected approval timeline: 8-12 hours

requirements.title: Required documentation set for traders
requirements.description: Trader onboarding requires ID, proof of address, beneficial ownership structure, source of funds and a business license.
requirements.quote: Documentation: ID + proof of address + beneficial ownership structure + source of funds + business license

requirements.title: Bi-weekly monitoring reviews, monthly for high volume
requirements.description: Ongoing monitoring for trader customers runs on a bi-weekly review cycle, moving to monthly for high volume customers.
requirements.quote: Monitoring: Bi-weekly reviews (monthly for high volume)

requirements.title: Detect structured transactions and baseline trading patterns
requirements.description: Compliance monitoring must watch for structured transactions and establish a baseline of normal trading patterns for the customer.
requirements.quote: Compliance considerations: Watch for structured transactions, establish trading patterns baseline

requirements.title: Risk assessment inputs for traders
requirements.description: The risk assessment step evaluates source countries, business model and beneficial ownership.
requirements.quote: Risk assessment: Based on source countries, business model, beneficial ownership

requirements.title: Medium CDD triggers enhanced documentation
requirements.description: When Medium CDD is triggered, enhanced documentation must be collected from the customer.
requirements.quote: Medium CDD triggered → Enhanced documentation required

requirements.title: Detailed compliance officer review of 15-20 minutes
requirements.description: A compliance officer performs a detailed manual review of trader applications lasting 15 to 20 minutes.
requirements.quote: Compliance officer reviews (15-20 minute detailed review)

requirements.title: Follow-up questions when risk factors present
requirements.description: If risk factors are present, the reviewer asks additional clarifying questions of the customer, such as explaining a trading relationship with a foreign supplier.
requirements.quote: Additional questions if risk factors present (e.g., "Explain trading relationship with Turkish supplier")

requirements.title: Escalation to senior compliance for final decision
requirements.description: A trader account is either approved or escalated to senior compliance, who makes the final decision.
requirements.quote: Account approved or escalated to senior compliance for final decision

requirements.title: Transaction monitoring enabled at activation
requirements.description: When a trader account is activated, transaction monitoring must be enabled on it.
requirements.quote: Account activated with transaction monitoring enabled

requirements.title: International trader onboarding journey
requirements.description: A managing director or finance manager of an import/reseller company onboards via a phone or video meeting, is risk assessed, provides enhanced documentation under Medium CDD, is reviewed by a compliance officer and is then approved or escalated before activation with monitoring.
requirements.quote: Customer onboarding meeting (phone/video)
requirements.trigger: Import/reseller company applies to open an account
requirements.happyPath: Onboarding meeting → risk assessment on source countries, business model and beneficial ownership → Medium CDD with enhanced documentation → 15-20 minute compliance officer review → approval → account activated with transaction monitoring enabled

requirements.title: Multinational subsidiary onboarding journey via relationship manager
requirements.description: A large multinational subsidiary or trading arm (decision maker: CFO, Treasury or Group compliance) is onboarded through a relationship-manager-led process rather than self-service, progressing through comprehensive supply chain risk assessment, source country analysis, enhanced CDD, a senior compliance officer meeting on risk acceptance, possible case-by-case transaction approval for high-risk suppliers, and approval with continuous monitoring plus quarterly re-assessment.
requirements.quote: Initial approach: Usually via relationship manager (not self-service)
requirements.actor: Relationship manager (on behalf of CFO / Treasury / Group compliance)
requirements.trigger: Multinational corporation or subsidiary approaches the institution to open an account
requirements.happyPath: Relationship manager initiates onboarding; comprehensive risk assessment with supply chain mapping and supplier list analysis is performed; high-risk source countries are flagged; enhanced CDD covers the supply chain; senior compliance officer meets to discuss risk acceptance; account is approved with continuous monitoring and quarterly re-assessment.

requirements.title: Standard CDD is legally sufficient for large established corporates
requirements.description: For large, established multinational companies, standard customer due diligence is legally sufficient as the baseline requirement.
requirements.quote: Standard CDD legally sufficient (large, established company)

requirements.title: Enhanced procedures triggered by transaction volume and correspondent banking exposure
requirements.description: Despite standard CDD being legally sufficient, enhanced procedures must be applied to multinational corporate customers because of their transaction volume and correspondent banking exposure.
requirements.quote: BUT: Enhanced procedures due to volume + correspondent banking exposure

requirements.title: Enhanced CDD extends to the supply chain
requirements.description: Enhanced due diligence for multinational corporates must be performed on the supply chain, not only on the applicant company itself, regardless of company size.
requirements.quote: Enhanced CDD (despite company size): Due diligence on supply chain, not just company itself

requirements.title: Approval timeline of 12-24 hours for multinational corporates
requirements.description: The expected end-to-end approval timeline for multinational corporation / subsidiary customers is 12 to 24 hours.
requirements.quote: Expected approval timeline: 12-24 hours

requirements.title: Required documentation set for multinational corporates
requirements.description: Onboarding a multinational corporate requires a corporate registry extract, parent company documentation, beneficial ownership information, banking references, and a compliance officer sign-off.
requirements.quote: Documentation: Corporate registry extract + parent company documentation + beneficial ownership + banking references + compliance officer sign-off

requirements.title: Weekly monitoring reviews for transactions over €1M or sanctions-flagged countries
requirements.description: Multinational corporate accounts are subject to weekly monitoring reviews covering transactions greater than €1M and any transactions involving sanctions-flagged countries.
requirements.quote: Monitoring: Weekly reviews (transactions >€1M, any sanctions-flagged countries)

requirements.title: Sanctions screening coverage of all suppliers and counterparties
requirements.description: Sanction screening for multinational corporate customers must cover all suppliers as well as all transaction counterparties, not just the customer entity.
requirements.quote: Compliance considerations: Sanction-screening must cover all suppliers + all transaction counterparties

requirements.title: Supply chain mapping and supplier list analysis
requirements.description: The system/process must support a comprehensive risk assessment that includes supply chain mapping and analysis of the customer's supplier list.
requirements.quote: Comprehensive risk assessment: Supply chain mapping, supplier list analysis

requirements.title: Flag high-risk jurisdictions in the supplier base
requirements.description: Source country analysis must flag any high-risk jurisdictions present in the customer's supplier base; supplier countries may include high-risk jurisdictions such as Turkey, Egypt and Vietnam.
requirements.quote: Source countries analysis: Flag any high-risk jurisdictions in supplier base

requirements.title: Senior compliance officer risk acceptance meeting
requirements.description: Onboarding a multinational corporate requires a meeting with a senior compliance officer to discuss and decide on risk acceptance.
requirements.quote: Senior compliance officer meeting: Discussion of risk acceptance

requirements.title: Case-by-case transaction approval for high-risk suppliers
requirements.description: Transactions involving high-risk suppliers may require individual, case-by-case approval.
requirements.quote: Possible case-by-case transaction approval for high-risk suppliers

requirements.title: Continuous monitoring and quarterly re-assessment after approval
requirements.description: Once approved, the multinational corporate account must be subject to continuous monitoring and a re-assessment every quarter.
requirements.quote: Account approved with continuous monitoring + quarterly re-assessment

requirements.title: Pre-approval escalation for new suppliers in high-risk countries
requirements.description: An escalation protocol must require pre-approval before the customer engages new suppliers located in high-risk countries.
requirements.quote: Escalation protocol: New suppliers in high-risk countries require pre-approval
requirements.trigger: Customer adds a new supplier based in a high-risk country

requirements.title: Beneficial ownership is the 100% parent company
requirements.description: For this persona, beneficial ownership is clear and resolves to the parent company, which holds 100% of the subsidiary; source of funds is the group treasury.
requirements.quote: Ownership: Parent company holding 100%

requirements.title: Mandatory Enhanced CDD for correspondent banking relationships
requirements.description: Correspondent banking relationships must always be subject to Enhanced Customer Due Diligence, as they are classified as high-risk under FATF guidance. No simplified or standard CDD path is permitted for this segment.
requirements.quote: Enhanced CDD mandatory (correspondent banking = high-risk per FATF)

requirements.title: Capture full ultimate ownership chain for foreign parent bank
requirements.description: For correspondent banking partners, beneficial ownership collection must cover the foreign parent company and the complete ultimate ownership chain, not just the immediate parent.
requirements.quote: Beneficial ownership: Foreign parent company + ultimate ownership chain

requirements.title: Source of funds established from cross-border bank flows
requirements.description: Source of funds assessment for correspondent banking partners is based on cross-border bank flows (settlement, trade finance, forex activity).
requirements.quote: Source of funds: Cross-border bank flows

requirements.title: Correspondent banking risk factor set
requirements.description: Risk assessment for correspondent banking partners must account for multiple jurisdictions, third-country correspondent exposure, foreign regulator oversight, and sanctions exposure through the correspondent network.
requirements.quote: Risk factors: **Multiple jurisdictions**, **Third-country correspondent exposure**, **Foreign regulator oversight**, **Sanctions exposure through correspondent network**

requirements.title: Approval timeline of 2-7 days for correspondent banking partners
requirements.description: Onboarding decisions for correspondent banking partners are expected to complete within 2 to 7 days.
requirements.quote: Expected approval timeline: 2-7 days

requirements.title: Required documentation package for correspondent banking partners
requirements.description: The system must collect banking license, parent company documentation, ultimate beneficial ownership covering the entire chain, correspondence list, and AML/CFT procedures documentation before approval.
requirements.quote: Documentation: Banking license + parent company documentation + ultimate beneficial ownership (entire chain) + correspondence list + AML/CFT procedures documentation

requirements.title: Monthly monitoring with transaction pattern analysis for layering
requirements.description: Correspondent banking relationships require monthly reviews combined with transaction pattern analysis specifically designed to detect layering activity.
requirements.quote: Monitoring: Monthly reviews + transaction pattern analysis (watch for layering activities)

requirements.title: Document acceptable correspondent relationships and decline sanctioned-jurisdiction exposure
requirements.description: The institution must document which correspondent relationships are acceptable and must decline any relationship where the correspondent extends into sanctioned jurisdictions.
requirements.quote: Must document acceptable correspondent relationships, decline if correspondent extends into sanctioned jurisdictions

requirements.title: Referral-based intake rather than self-service
requirements.description: Correspondent banking partners are normally introduced via a relationship manager; self-service onboarding is not the standard route for this segment.
requirements.quote: Referral: Usually via relationship manager (not self-service)

requirements.title: Initial due diligence research on foreign bank and regulator reputation
requirements.description: Before proceeding, extensive research must be performed on the foreign bank and on the reputation of its home regulator.
requirements.quote: Initial due diligence: Extensive research on foreign bank + regulator reputation

requirements.title: Senior compliance officer pursue-or-decline gate
requirements.description: A senior compliance officer must review the initial due diligence and make an explicit decision to pursue or decline the correspondent relationship before further work proceeds.
requirements.quote: Senior compliance officer review: Decision to pursue or decline relationship

requirements.title: Certification from foreign regulator required when proceeding
requirements.description: If the relationship is pursued, comprehensive documentation plus certification from the foreign regulator must be collected.
requirements.quote: If proceeding: Collect comprehensive documentation + certification from foreign regulator

requirements.title: Legal review of correspondent agreement and AML procedures alignment
requirements.description: A legal review must confirm the correspondent agreement and verify alignment of the counterparty's AML procedures with the institution's requirements.
requirements.quote: Legal review: Correspondent agreement + AML procedures alignment

requirements.title: Dual sign-off by senior management and compliance officer
requirements.description: Final approval of a correspondent banking relationship requires sign-off from both senior management and a compliance officer.
requirements.quote: Final approval: Senior management + compliance officer sign-off

requirements.title: Designated compliance monitoring for correspondent transactions
requirements.description: On implementation, dedicated compliance monitoring must be assigned to transactions arising from the correspondent relationship.
requirements.quote: Implementation: Designated compliance monitoring for correspondent transactions

requirements.title: Quarterly reviews and annual re-assessment of correspondent relationships
requirements.description: Ongoing management of correspondent banking relationships includes quarterly reviews, an annual re-assessment, and correspondent update procedures.
requirements.quote: Ongoing: Quarterly reviews + annual re-assessment + correspondent update procedures

requirements.title: Correspondent banking partner onboarding journey
requirements.description: End-to-end journey for a foreign bank correspondent partner: relationship-manager referral, extensive due diligence on the bank and its regulator, senior compliance pursue/decline decision, documentation and regulator certification collection, legal review, dual sign-off, implementation of designated monitoring, and ongoing periodic review.
requirements.quote: Persona 4: Correspondent Banking Partner (5% of customer base)
requirements.actor: Compliance officer / Head of Correspondent Banking of a foreign bank
requirements.trigger: Relationship manager refers a foreign correspondent bank for onboarding
requirements.happyPath: Referral received, initial due diligence completed, senior compliance officer decides to pursue, comprehensive documentation and foreign regulator certification collected, legal review of correspondent agreement and AML alignment passes, senior management and compliance officer sign off, designated compliance monitoring implemented, and quarterly reviews with annual re-assessment commence.

requirements.title: Correspondent banking segment classified as High / Extreme KYC complexity
requirements.description: Correspondent banking partners are classified at the highest KYC complexity tier, driving the enhanced due diligence, documentation and monitoring obligations for this segment.
requirements.quote: **KYC Complexity:** High / Extreme

requirements.title: Screen all customers, suppliers and transaction counterparties against sanctions lists
requirements.description: The system must screen every customer, supplier and transaction counterparty against the full set of applicable sanctions lists (OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated, UN SC Consolidated, national lists of Germany/France/Italy, and sectoral sanctions).
requirements.quote: All customers + suppliers + transaction counterparties screened against:

requirements.title: Screening against OFAC SDN List
requirements.description: Because ETFB maintains correspondent banking relationships with US institutions, screening against the US Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list is mandatory.
requirements.quote: OFAC SDN List (US Treasury - critical due to correspondent banking with US)

requirements.title: Screening against EU, UN and national sanctions lists
requirements.description: Screening must cover the EU Consolidated Sanctions List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List and the national sanctions lists of ETFB's primary markets (Germany, France, Italy).
requirements.quote: National sanctions lists (Germany, France, Italy - ETFB's primary markets)

requirements.title: Screening against Russia sectoral sanctions
requirements.description: Sectoral sanctions, specifically Russia sectoral sanctions which are sensitive for trade finance business, must be included in the screening scope.
requirements.quote: Sectoral sanctions: Russia sectoral sanctions (trade finance-sensitive)

requirements.title: Freeze account and file SAR on sanctioned supplier country exposure
requirements.description: If a customer is found to import from a sanctioned jurisdiction such as Iran, the account must be immediately frozen and a suspicious activity report filed.
requirements.quote: Suppliers must be screened: If customer imports from Iran, account must be immediately frozen + SAR filed

requirements.title: Real-time counterparty screening within 5 seconds
requirements.description: Screening of a transaction counterparty must complete in real time, in under 5 seconds per counterparty.
requirements.quote: Real-time screening: <5 seconds per transaction counterparty

requirements.title: Weekly re-screening of all active customers and suppliers
requirements.description: A background task must re-screen all active customers and suppliers against sanctions lists on a weekly basis.
requirements.quote: Weekly re-screening: All active customers + suppliers (background task)

requirements.title: Match threshold of exact or >90% similarity
requirements.description: Only exact matches or high-confidence matches above 90% similarity may be raised as sanctions hits.
requirements.quote: Match threshold: Exact or high-confidence match (>90% similarity) only

requirements.title: False positive review decision within 2 hours
requirements.description: A compliance officer must reach a decision on a flagged potential false positive within 2 hours.
requirements.quote: False positive review: Compliance officer decision within 2 hours

requirements.title: Automatic SAR for non-cooperative country trade
requirements.description: Any trade involving non-cooperative countries (Iran, North Korea) must automatically trigger a SAR filing.
requirements.quote: Non-cooperative countries: Iran, North Korea (any trade = automatic SAR)

requirements.title: Enhanced review for FATF grey-list transactions
requirements.description: Any transaction to a FATF grey-list country triggers an enhanced review.
requirements.quote: FATF grey-list: Any transaction to grey-list country triggers enhanced review

requirements.title: Enhanced documentation for corruption-index countries
requirements.description: Transactions involving Turkey, Egypt, Vietnam or Pakistan require enhanced documentation due to corruption index concerns.
requirements.quote: Corruption index concerns: Turkey, Egypt, Vietnam, Pakistan (require enhanced documentation)

requirements.title: Automatic rejection and SAR for conflict zone transactions
requirements.description: Any transaction involving conflict zones (Syria, Yemen, Iraq) must be automatically rejected and a SAR filed.
requirements.quote: Conflict zones: Syria, Yemen, Iraq (any transaction = automatic rejection + SAR)

requirements.title: Real-time destination country screening against high-risk list
requirements.description: The system must match the transaction destination country against the high-risk jurisdiction list in real time.
requirements.quote: Transaction destination country matched against high-risk list (real-time)

requirements.title: Halt high-risk transaction pending compliance approval
requirements.description: If the destination country is high-risk, the transaction must be halted and compliance approval obtained before it may proceed.
requirements.quote: If high-risk: Halt transaction, require compliance approval before proceeding

requirements.title: Document business justification for high-risk jurisdiction transactions
requirements.description: A business justification must be documented for any transaction involving a high-risk jurisdiction.
requirements.quote: Document: Business justification for high-risk jurisdiction transaction

requirements.title: Immediate investigation of geographic anomalies
requirements.description: Geographic anomalies, such as a domestic customer suddenly transacting with North Korea, must trigger immediate investigation.
requirements.quote: Escalation: Geographic anomalies (e.g., domestic customer suddenly transacting with North Korea) = immediate investigation

requirements.title: Periodic re-assessment for grey-list adjacent supplier relationships
requirements.description: Customers with suppliers in low-risk but grey-list adjacent countries such as Vietnam are subject to periodic re-assessment.
requirements.quote: Customer may have suppliers in Vietnam (low-risk but grey-list adjacent) → Periodic re-assessment

requirements.title: Legitimate import from high-risk country auto-flagged for compliance review
requirements.description: A legitimate import transaction from Turkey is automatically flagged for compliance review.
requirements.quote: Customer may import from Turkey (legitimate) → Auto-flag for compliance review

requirements.title: Customer payment to Iran-linked supplier blocked and reported
requirements.description: When a customer attempts a payment to an Iran-linked supplier, the transaction is blocked, escalated and a SAR is filed.
requirements.quote: Customer accidentally attempts payment to Iran-linked supplier → Transaction blocked, escalated, SAR filed
requirements.trigger: Customer attempts payment to an Iran-linked supplier
requirements.happyPath: Destination country is screened in real time, matched to the non-cooperative country list, the transaction is blocked, escalated to compliance and a SAR is filed.

requirements.title: Automated PEP screening at onboarding with quarterly re-screening
requirements.description: The system must perform automated PEP screening when an account is created and re-screen customers on a quarterly cycle to capture newly acquired PEP status.
requirements.quote: Automated PEP screening at account creation + quarterly re-screening

requirements.title: Beneficial owner family-name screening against PEP database
requirements.description: The system must screen beneficial owners' surnames against the PEP database to identify family members and close associates of politically exposed persons.
requirements.quote: Family member screening: Check beneficial owners' surnames against PEP database

requirements.title: State-owned enterprise supplier flagging
requirements.description: The system must identify whether a customer's supplier is a state-owned enterprise and flag it. SOE status is legitimate but triggers enhanced review rather than PEP treatment.
requirements.quote: State-owned enterprise identification: Flag supplier if SOE (legitimate, but requires enhanced review)

requirements.title: Two-person review required for PEP relationship approval
requirements.description: A single compliance officer may not approve a PEP relationship on their own; approval requires a two-person review supported by documentation.
requirements.quote: Approval hierarchy: Sole compliance officer cannot approve PEP relationship; requires 2-person review + documentation

requirements.title: Direct relative of a government minister is PEP-related
requirements.description: A customer who is a direct relative of a government minister must be classified as PEP-related.
requirements.quote: Customer is direct relative of government minister (clear PEP-related)

requirements.title: Beneficial owner who is a foreign government official is a PEP
requirements.description: Where a customer's beneficial owner is a government official in a non-EU country, that relationship must be treated as a PEP.
requirements.quote: Customer's beneficial owner is a government official in non-EU country (PEP)

requirements.title: Government-connected suppliers receive enhanced scrutiny, not PEP status
requirements.description: A supplier that is a state-owned enterprise does not make the customer a PEP, but the government connection requires enhanced scrutiny.
requirements.quote: Customer's supplier is a state-owned enterprise (not PEP, but government-connected = enhanced scrutiny)

requirements.title: Trade with government agencies requires approval
requirements.description: Transactions involving trade with government agencies are legitimate business but must go through an approval step before proceeding.
requirements.quote: Transaction involves trade with government agencies (legitimate business, but requires approval)

requirements.title: Report transactions exceeding €10,000 cumulative daily
requirements.description: All transactions above €10,000, measured on a cumulative daily basis, must be reported in line with the EU currency transaction reporting requirement.
requirements.quote: **EU requirement:** Report all transactions >€10,000 (cumulative daily)

requirements.title: Real-time cumulative transaction tracking over a daily rolling window
requirements.description: The system must track customer transaction totals cumulatively in real time using a daily rolling window, so that the €10,000 reporting threshold is evaluated against aggregated daily activity rather than single payments.
requirements.quote: Real-time cumulative tracking (daily rolling window)

requirements.title: Investigate material changes in customer transaction patterns
requirements.description: When a customer's transaction pattern changes materially — for example, from a typical one transaction per week to five transactions per day — the case must be investigated.
requirements.quote: Pattern detection: If customer's pattern changes (e.g., usually 1 transaction/week, suddenly 5 transactions/day) = investigate

requirements.title: Automated flag for analyst review on suspected structuring
requirements.description: The system must automatically raise a flag for analyst review whenever structuring is suspected.
requirements.quote: Automated flag for analyst review if structuring suspected

requirements.title: File SAR within 5 working days of confirmed structuring
requirements.description: Where a structuring pattern is confirmed, a Suspicious Activity Report must be filed within 5 working days.
requirements.quote: SAR filing: If structuring pattern confirmed, file SAR within 5 working days

requirements.title: Detect repeated sub-threshold payments as structuring
requirements.description: Repeated payments deliberately kept just below the €10,000 threshold that cumulatively settle a larger obligation (e.g. €9.8K per day for 6 days against €50K of imported goods) must be treated as a structuring indicator.
requirements.quote: Example: Customer imports €50K of goods, pays €9.8K per day for 6 days (structuring)

requirements.title: Distinguish legitimate multi-payer daily activity from structuring
requirements.description: Detection logic must account for legitimate trade finance activity, such as multiple small customers paying daily into the ETFB account, so these are not misclassified as structuring.
requirements.quote: Legitimate example: Multiple small customers pay daily into ETFB account

requirements.title: Indirect due diligence on correspondent's customer base
requirements.description: ETFB must perform due diligence on the correspondent bank's customer base indirectly, via screening of the correspondent, since ETFB has no direct relationship with the correspondent's customers.
requirements.quote: Due diligence on correspondent customer base (indirectly, via correspondent screening)

requirements.title: Right to audit correspondent's AML procedures
requirements.description: ETFB must retain and be able to exercise a right to audit the correspondent bank's AML procedures.
requirements.quote: Right to audit: ETFB must be able to audit correspondent's AML procedures

requirements.title: Documented acceptable correspondent customer business
requirements.description: ETFB must document what types of business it will accept through a correspondent relationship.
requirements.quote: Acceptable correspondent customer business: ETFB must document what types of business it will accept through correspondent

requirements.title: Correspondent must screen its customers against sanctions lists
requirements.description: As a condition of the correspondent relationship, the correspondent bank must screen its own customers against sanctions lists.
requirements.quote: Sanctions compliance: Correspondent must screen their customers against sanctions lists

requirements.title: Correspondent due diligence questionnaire
requirements.description: The system must support a due diligence questionnaire for correspondent banks covering KYC procedures, AML training and screening processes.
requirements.quote: Due diligence questionnaire for correspondent: KYC procedures, AML training, screening processes

requirements.title: Annual AML/CFT certification from correspondent
requirements.description: The correspondent must provide an annual attestation that its AML/CFT procedures comply with standards; the system must capture and track this certification.
requirements.quote: Annual certification: Correspondent attests AML/CFT procedures comply with standards

requirements.title: Monitoring of all correspondent transactions
requirements.description: ETFB must monitor all transactions flowing through correspondent relationships for suspicious patterns.
requirements.quote: Transaction monitoring: ETFB monitors all correspondent transactions for suspicious patterns

requirements.title: Right to investigate suspicious correspondent transactions
requirements.description: Where a transaction is suspicious, ETFB must be able to request details of the underlying transaction and parties from the correspondent bank.
requirements.quote: Right to investigate: If suspicious transaction, ETFB must be able to request details from correspondent

requirements.title: Support onboarding volume of 200-500 new customers per month
requirements.description: The system must handle a monthly intake of between 200 and 500 new customers, with variability driven by seasonality and marketing campaigns.
requirements.quote: **New customers/month:** 200-500 (varies by season, marketing campaigns)

requirements.title: Support document intake of 600-1000 documents per day
requirements.description: The system must process between 600 and 1000 new documents per day, allowing for customer resubmissions where documents are rejected.
requirements.quote: **New documents/day:** 600-1000 (customers may resubmit if rejected)

requirements.title: Support 50-100 compliance reviews per day
requirements.description: The system must support a daily throughput of 50 to 100 compliance reviews, with volume varying according to queue backlog.
requirements.quote: **Compliance reviews/day:** 50-100 (varies by queue backlog)

requirements.title: Process 2000-5000 transactions per day
requirements.description: The platform is high-volume and must process between 2000 and 5000 transactions per day.
requirements.quote: **Transactions/day:** 2000-5000 (high-volume platform)

requirements.title: Handle 20-50 monitoring flags per day
requirements.description: The system must generate and manage 20 to 50 monitoring flags per day arising from transaction screening and risk review alerts.
requirements.quote: **Monitoring flags/day:** 20-50 (transaction screening, risk review alerts)

requirements.title: Compliance team staffing constraint
requirements.description: All processing volumes must be absorbed by a compliance team of 8-10 analysts plus 1-2 compliance officers.
requirements.quote: **Operational constraint:** Compliance team = 8-10 analysts + 1-2 officers

requirements.title: Efficient manual review workflow
requirements.description: Manual review workflows must be designed for efficiency so that the small compliance team can cope with the volume.
requirements.quote: - Manual reviews must be efficient

requirements.title: Automation to manage processing volume
requirements.description: Automation is critical to manage the stated processing volumes given the limited size of the compliance team.
requirements.quote: - Automation critical to manage volume

requirements.title: 24-hour SLA for standard CDD approval
requirements.description: Standard CDD cases must be approved within 24 hours; this SLA is acknowledged as operationally challenging at current volumes.
requirements.quote: SLA: Standard CDD approval within 24 hours (operationally challenging with current volume)

requirements.title: All staff must understand AML/CFT obligations
requirements.description: Every member of staff is required to be trained so that they understand the institution's AML/CFT obligations, covering both recent hires (1-2 years experience) and experienced staff (5+ years).
requirements.quote: **Training requirement:** All staff must understand AML/CFT obligations

requirements.title: Staff trained on the new KYC platform
requirements.description: Compliance and operational staff must receive training on the new KYC platform before/while using it, so they can operate the system correctly.
requirements.quote: **System training:** Staff must be trained on new KYC platform

requirements.title: Training refreshed as regulations change
requirements.description: Training content must be refreshed whenever regulations change, so staff knowledge remains current with the applicable AML/CFT rules.
requirements.quote: **Ongoing updates:** As regulations change, training must be refreshed
requirements.trigger: A change in applicable AML/CFT regulations

requirements.title: All decisions must be defensible in regulatory audit
requirements.description: Every compliance decision must be documented such that it can be defended during a regulatory audit.
requirements.quote: **Documentation:** All decisions must be defensible in regulatory audit

requirements.title: Account creation integrates with customer management system
requirements.description: The KYC platform's account creation flow must integrate with the core banking customer management system.
requirements.quote: Core banking system: Account creation must integrate with customer management system

requirements.title: Transaction monitoring integrates with payment rails
requirements.description: Transaction monitoring must be integrated with the payment system / payment rails so that payment activity is captured for monitoring.
requirements.quote: Payment system: Transaction monitoring must integrate with payment rails

requirements.title: Uploaded documents retrievable within 10 days
requirements.description: Documents uploaded to the document management system must be retrievable within 10 days in order to satisfy regulator requests.
requirements.quote: Document management: Uploaded documents must be retrievable within 10 days (for regulator requests)
requirements.trigger: A regulator request for customer documentation

requirements.title: SAR filing integrates with financial intelligence reporting
requirements.description: The reporting system must support SAR filing through integration with financial intelligence reporting channels.
requirements.quote: Reporting system: SAR filing must integrate with financial intelligence reporting

requirements.title: External system integrations for screening and identity
requirements.description: The platform must integrate with external systems including sanctions screening services, PEP databases and national ID registries.
requirements.quote: External systems: Sanctions screening, PEP databases, national ID registries

requirements.title: Support random audit sample of 30 customer files across risk levels
requirements.description: The system must be able to produce a random sample of 30 customer files spanning all risk levels on auditor request, as this is the expected regulatory audit sampling approach.
requirements.quote: Auditors will request: 30 customer files (random sample across risk levels)

requirements.title: Retrieve verification evidence for an individual customer
requirements.description: For any given customer, the system must be able to display the verification performed, so an auditor asking to see the verification for that customer can be satisfied.
requirements.quote: "Show me the verification for this customer"

requirements.title: Explain approval timing and decision rationale
requirements.description: The system must be able to justify why a customer was approved within a given elapsed time (e.g. 4 hours), evidencing that the accelerated decision followed the required steps.
requirements.quote: "Why was this customer approved in 4 hours?"

requirements.title: Document the beneficial ownership determination
requirements.description: The system must record and be able to produce documentation of how beneficial ownership was determined for a customer.
requirements.quote: "Document the beneficial ownership determination"

requirements.title: Show risk score calculation for PEP-related customers
requirements.description: The system must be able to reproduce and display the risk score calculation for a customer, including PEP-related customers, in a form an auditor can follow.
requirements.quote: "Show me the risk score calculation for this PEP-related customer"

requirements.title: Provide SAR filing records for the last 2 years
requirements.description: The system must be able to provide records of Suspicious Activity Report filings covering the most recent two years on auditor request.
requirements.quote: "Provide SAR filing records for the last 2 years"

requirements.title: Complete audit trail, explainable decisions and timely document retrieval
requirements.description: The system must provide a complete audit trail, decisions that can be explained, and timely retrieval of supporting documents to satisfy regulatory audits.
requirements.quote: System must support: Complete audit trail, explainable decisions, timely document retrieval

requirements.title: Reflect EU sanctions list changes within AML5 update cycle
requirements.description: The system must be updated to reflect EU sanctions list changes, which occur alongside AML5 updates approximately every 2 years.
requirements.quote: **AML5 updates:** Every 2 years, EU sanctions list changes; system must reflect updates

requirements.title: FATF mutual evaluation failure may trigger regulatory restrictions
requirements.description: If ETFB fails a FATF mutual evaluation, regulators may impose restrictions on the business; this regulatory exposure must be accounted for.
requirements.quote: **FATF evaluations:** If ETFB fails FATF mutual evaluation, regulators may impose restrictions

requirements.title: Support country-level local adaptations
