requirements.description: The system must accommodate individual country amendments to national regulations, specifically for Germany, France and Italy, which may require local adaptations.
requirements.quote: **National regulations:** Individual country amendments (Germany, France, Italy) may require local adaptations

requirements.title: Configurable rules engine without code changes
requirements.description: The rules engine must be configurable without requiring code changes, so that regulatory shifts can be accommodated.
requirements.quote: **System flexibility:** Rules engine must be configurable without code changes (to accommodate regulatory shifts)

requirements.title: AI transparency for decision support
requirements.description: Where the KYC platform uses AI/ML for decision support rather than autonomous decision-making, transparency about the AI use is required.
requirements.quote: Decision support (not autonomous) → Transparency required

requirements.title: AI-driven risk scoring must be explainable
requirements.description: If the risk scoring model is AI-driven, the model must be explainable.
requirements.quote: Risk scoring: If AI-driven, model must be explainable

requirements.title: Bias audit of model approval rates
requirements.description: The model must be audited for nationality and gender bias in approval rates.
requirements.quote: Bias testing: Must audit model for nationality/gender bias in approval rates

requirements.title: Human review of account approval decisions
requirements.description: AI cannot be the sole determinant of account approval; a human must review and approve the decision.
requirements.quote: Human review: AI cannot solely determine account approval; human must review/approve

requirements.title: Retain AI model documentation for 5 years
requirements.description: Model version, training data and performance metrics must be documented and maintained for 5 years.
requirements.quote: Documentation: Model version, training data, performance metrics must be maintained for 5 years

requirements.title: Standard customer approval within 4 hours
requirements.description: Standard-risk customer approval must complete in under 4 hours, a 50% reduction from the current 8-hour baseline.
requirements.quote: Standard customer approval <4 hours (50% reduction from current 8 hours)

requirements.title: Medium/High risk customer approval within 24 hours
requirements.description: Approval for medium and high risk customers must complete in under 24 hours, a 30% improvement over the current 32 hours.
requirements.quote: Medium/High customer approval <24 hours (30% improvement from current 32 hours)

requirements.title: Manual document review under 10 minutes per customer
requirements.description: Time spent on manual document review must be reduced to under 10 minutes per customer, from the current 25 minutes.
requirements.quote: Manual document review time <10 minutes per customer (currently 25 minutes)

requirements.title: False rejection rate below 3%
requirements.description: The false rejection rate must fall below 3%, down from the current 8%.
requirements.quote: False rejection rate <3% (currently 8%)

requirements.title: Support 500 new customers per month without added headcount
requirements.description: The compliance team must be able to onboard 500 new customers per month with existing staff, requiring no new hiring.
requirements.quote: Compliance team capacity: Support 500 new customers/month without hiring

requirements.title: All customers verified before account activation
requirements.description: 100% of customers must be verified before their account is activated; current compliance is 99.5%.
requirements.quote: 100% of customers verified before account activation (current: 99.5% compliant)

requirements.title: Full sanctions screening coverage across customers, suppliers and counterparties
requirements.description: Sanctions screening must cover 100% of customers, suppliers and counterparties.
requirements.quote: Sanctions screening coverage: 100% of customers + suppliers + counterparties

requirements.title: SAR filings 100% within regulatory timeline
requirements.description: All Suspicious Activity Reports must be filed within the applicable regulatory timeline, with 100% timeliness.
requirements.quote: SAR filing timeliness: 100% filed within regulatory timeline

requirements.title: Audit documentation retrievable within 10 days
requirements.description: All documentation must be retrievable within 10 days to demonstrate audit readiness.
requirements.quote: Audit readiness: All documentation retrievable within 10 days

requirements.title: System uptime of 99.9%
requirements.description: The system must maintain 99.9% uptime because correspondent banking operations are critical and cannot tolerate downtime.
requirements.quote: System uptime: 99.9% (correspondent banking critical, cannot have downtime)

requirements.title: Screening latency under 5 seconds per customer
requirements.description: Screening must return results in less than 5 seconds per customer to preserve user experience.
requirements.quote: Screening latency: <5 seconds per customer (user experience)

requirements.title: Support minimum 15 concurrent compliance analysts
requirements.description: The system must support at least 15 compliance analysts working concurrently.
requirements.quote: Concurrent users: Support 15 concurrent compliance analysts minimum

requirements.title: Five-year data retention with recovery SLA under 10 days
requirements.description: Data must be retained for 5 years, with a recovery service level of less than 10 days.
requirements.quote: Data retention: 5-year retention with recovery SLA <10 days

requirements.title: Requirements and design sign-off in first two weeks
requirements.description: Requirements gathering must be complete and the platform design formally approved during weeks 1-2 of the implementation timeline, before development begins.
requirements.quote: Requirements gathering complete, platform design approved

requirements.title: Core platform development window (weeks 3-6)
requirements.description: Development of the platform's core features is scheduled across weeks 3 to 6 of the delivery plan.
requirements.quote: Platform development (core features)

requirements.title: User acceptance testing with 5 compliance analysts
requirements.description: During weeks 7-8 the platform must undergo user acceptance testing performed by the compliance team, staffed with 5 analysts as testers.
requirements.quote: User acceptance testing with compliance team (5 analysts testing)
requirements.trigger: Completion of core platform development at end of week 6
requirements.happyPath: Five compliance analysts execute UAT scenarios on the platform during weeks 7-8 and record results ahead of training and go-live preparation.

requirements.title: Training and go-live preparation in week 9
requirements.description: Week 9 is allocated to user training and go-live preparation activities.
requirements.quote: Training + go-live preparation

requirements.title: Parallel legacy system run for 2 weeks after go-live
requirements.description: At go-live in week 10, the legacy system must continue to run in parallel as a backup for 2 weeks.
requirements.quote: Go-live (with parallel legacy system running for 2 weeks backup)

requirements.title: Legacy system retirement at cutover in week 12
requirements.description: In week 12 the programme performs cutover and retires the legacy system, ending parallel running.
requirements.quote: Cutover - legacy system retirement

requirements.title: Compliance team fully trained before go-live
requirements.description: Go-live is conditional on the entire compliance team being trained and comfortable using the platform.
requirements.quote: All compliance team trained and comfortable with platform

requirements.title: At least 50 customer files onboarded in UAT
requirements.description: Go-live requires that a minimum of 50 customer files have been successfully onboarded during user acceptance testing.
requirements.quote: At least 50 customer files successfully onboarded in UAT

requirements.title: No critical bugs in verification, screening and approval workflows
requirements.description: Go-live requires zero critical defects in the core workflows of verification, screening and approval.
requirements.quote: No critical bugs in core workflows (verification, screening, approval)

requirements.title: Audit trail and reporting functions verified working
requirements.description: Go-live requires that the audit trail and reporting functionality operate correctly.
requirements.quote: Audit trail and reporting functions working correctly

requirements.title: Rollback plan documented and tested
requirements.description: Go-live requires a rollback plan that has been both documented and tested.
requirements.quote: Rollback plan documented and tested

requirements.title: Video identity verification for remote onboarding (open decision)
requirements.description: Open question on whether the platform must support video-based identity verification for remote onboarding, or whether phone-based verification alone is sufficient. Decision pending; scope of remote identification capability is undetermined.
requirements.quote: Should we support for remote onboarding, or phone-based verification only?

requirements.title: Compliance officer-configurable auto-approval for low-risk customers (open decision)
requirements.description: Open question on whether compliance officers may define auto-approval rules for low-risk customers, with the illustrative criterion of domestic SMEs with less than €1M annual trade. Threshold and permissibility not yet confirmed.
requirements.quote: Should we allow compliance officer to set auto-approval rules for low-risk customers (e.g., domestic SMEs with <€1M annual trade)?

requirements.title: Escalation path for correspondent banking approval (open decision)
requirements.description: The escalation and approval path for correspondent banking relationships is undefined, including whether Legal must be involved in the approval chain.
requirements.quote: What's the escalation path for approving correspondent banking relationships? (Legal involvement required?)

requirements.title: Supplier list collection — mandatory or optional (open decision)
requirements.description: Open question on whether customers must provide a supplier list as part of onboarding data collection, or whether supplying it is optional. Affects supplier screening scope.
requirements.quote: Should customers be required to provide supplier list, or optional?

requirements.title: Impact of non-EU geographic expansion on regulatory requirements (open decision)
requirements.description: Open question on how regulatory requirements would change if ETFB expands to non-EU countries such as UAE or Singapore. Jurisdictional configurability of the compliance rules is not yet determined.
requirements.quote: If ETFB expands to non-EU countries (e.g., UAE, Singapore), how will regulatory requirements change?
